words.example_zh: 老师把心脏比作泵。
words.collocation_hint: analogy between; draw an analogy; by analogy with
words.mnemonics: ana（类似）+log（说）→ 把两个东西放在一起说，就是类比。

words.translation: 分析；分析机; 分析员; 分析; 分析程序

The result of such a process.
The mathematical study of functions, sequences, series, limits, derivatives and integrals.

words.mnemonics: ana-分开+lysis松开，把东西拆开来看，就是分析。

words.collocation_hint: analytical skills; analytical thinking; an analytical approach
words.mnemonics: ana-（分开）+lyt（解开）+ical（形容词后缀），把事物拆开来看，就是分析的。

words.translation: 忿怒；激怒, 使发怒；发怒

defs.text: Pain or stinging.

words.example_zh: 我们应该从不同角度看这个问题。

defs.text: The measure of such a figure. In the case of a plane angle, this is the ratio (or proportional to the ratio) of the arc length to the radius of a section of a circle cut by the two rays, centered at their common point. In the case of a solid angle, this is the ratio of the surface area to the square of the radius of the section of a sphere.
defs.ex: The angle between lines A and B is π/4 radians, or 45 degrees.

defs.text: A corner where two walls intersect.
defs.ex: an angle of a building

words.exam_meaning: n. 角, 角度, 角落；vi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度；vt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取

words.collocation_hint: wedding anniversary; celebrate an anniversary; the anniversary of

words.example_zh: 老师选择了适合孩子年龄的语言。

defs.text: To make suitable; to suit.
To take to oneself; to claim or use, especially as by an exclusive right.
defs.ex: Let no man appropriate the use of a common benefit.

defs.text: To set apart for, or assign to, a particular person or use, especially in exclusion of all others; with to or for.
defs.ex: A spot of ground is appropriated for a garden.

words.exam_meaning: a. 适当的；适当的, 拨出, 占用
words.collocation_hint: appropriate for; appropriate to; be appropriate that
words.mnemonics: ap(加强)+propri(自己的)+ate→使成为自己的→占用；引申为适合的→适当的

words.example_en: The project has received official approval.
words.example_zh: 这个项目已获得官方批准。

defs.text: An expression granting permission; an indication of agreement with a proposal; an acknowledgement that a person, thing or event meets requirements.
defs.ex: I need to get an approval on this purchase order.

defs.text: An expression of favorable acceptance and encouragement; a compliment that also condones.
defs.ex: Words of approval never seem to come from him.

defs.text: Something mailed by a seller to a collector to match their stated interests; the collector can approve of or return the item.

words.exam_meaning: n. 赞成, 批准；核准
words.collocation_hint: give approval; meet with approval; with the approval of
words.mnemonics: ap（向）+prove（证明）+al（名词后缀）→向人证明可行→获得赞成、批准。

words.translation: 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据；赞许
words.example_en: The board approved the budget by a large majority.
words.example_zh: 董事会以压倒多数批准了预算。
words.exam_meaning: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据；vi. 赞许
words.collocation_hint: approve of; approve a plan; officially approve
words.mnemonics: ap(加强)+prove(证明)，反复证明你行，所以得到“赞同”和“核准”。

words.example_en: The report gives an apt description of the situation.
words.example_zh: 报告对形势的描述很贴切。
words.collocation_hint: apt to do; an apt description; apt for
words.mnemonics: 谐音“爱扑他”——他容易扑过来，行为很恰当？联想：容易做某事，且做得恰当。

words.example_en: The decision seemed arbitrary and unfair.
words.example_zh: 这个决定显得武断且不公。
words.collocation_hint: an arbitrary decision; arbitrary rules; arbitrary power
words.mnemonics: arbit(仲裁)+rary→仲裁者说了算，很武断，随意决定。

words.example_en: The novel's hero is an archetype of the self-made man.
words.example_zh: 小说主人公是白手起家者的原型。
words.collocation_hint: an archetype of; the archetype for; cultural archetype
words.mnemonics: arch（首要）+ type（类型）= 首要的类型，即原型、典型。

words.translation: 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者
words.example_en: The architect designed the new library.
words.example_zh: 建筑师设计了新图书馆。

defs.text: A professional who designs buildings or other structures, or who prepares plans and superintends construction.
defs.ex: Plato made the causes of things to be matter, ideas, and an efficient architect.

defs.text: A person who plans, devises or contrives the achievement of a desired result.
defs.ex: Peisistratus was the first architect of the Iliad and the Odyssey.

defs.text: A title given to architects. Usually capitalized or abbreviated as Arch./Ar. before the person's name.

words.exam_meaning: n. 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者
words.collocation_hint: architect of; a leading architect; the architect of reform
words.mnemonics: arch（拱形）+ tect（工匠），造拱形的人就是建筑师，引申为缔造者。

words.translation: 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地；区域
words.example_en: The government is investing heavily in rural areas.
words.example_zh: 政府正在农村地区大力投资。

defs.text: A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units.
A particular geographic region.
Any particular extent of surface, especially an empty or unused extent.
defs.ex: The photo is a little dark in that area.

words.exam_meaning: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地；区域
words.collocation_hint: in the area of; urban area; key area
words.mnemonics: area谐音“爱丽儿”，小美人鱼活动的区域就是她的面积范围。

words.translation: 提出理由, 争论, 辩论；主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
words.example_en: Some economists argue that inflation will remain low.
words.example_zh: 一些经济学家主张通货膨胀将保持在低位。

defs.text: To show grounds for concluding (that); to indicate, imply.
To debate, disagree or discuss opposing or differing viewpoints.
defs.ex: He also argued for stronger methods to be used against China.

defs.text: To have an argument, a quarrel.

words.collocation_hint: argue that; argue for; argue against
words.mnemonics: argue=arg(银)+ue，争论时像银针一样针锋相对，主张说服对方。

words.translation: 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量；参数
words.example_en: His argument in favor of free trade is convincing.
words.example_zh: 他支持自由贸易的论点很有说服力。

defs.text: A fact or statement used to support a proposition; a reason.
A verbal dispute; a quarrel.
A process of reasoning.

words.exam_meaning: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量；参数
words.collocation_hint: make an argument; a strong argument; the argument for
words.mnemonics: argu（争吵）+ment（名词后缀）→ 争吵时摆出的理由就是论据。

words.translation: 站立, 出现, 起来
words.example_en: New problems arise as the city grows.
words.example_zh: 随着城市发展,新问题不断出现。

defs.text: To come up from a lower to a higher position.
defs.ex: to arise from a kneeling posture

defs.text: To come up from one's bed or place of repose; to get up.
defs.ex: He arose early in the morning.

defs.text: To spring up; to come into action, being, or notice; to become operative, sensible, or visible; to begin to act a part; to present itself.
defs.ex: A cloud arose and covered the sun.

words.exam_meaning: vi. 站立, 出现, 起来
words.collocation_hint: arise from; problems arise; arise out of
confusable_words: rise / raise / arise — rise 不及物(上升),raise 及物(举起/提高),arise 不及物(出现/产生)
words.mnemonics: a(加强)+rise(升起)，问题像太阳一样“升起”=出现。

words.example_en: The army was sent to help after the earthquake.
words.example_zh: 地震后军队被派去救援。

defs.text: A large, highly organized military force, concerned mainly with ground (rather than air or naval) operations.
defs.ex: The army was sent in to quell the uprising.

defs.text: The governmental agency in charge of a state's army.
defs.ex: The army opposed the legislature's involvement.

defs.text: A large group of people working toward the same purpose.
defs.ex: It took an army of accountants to uncover the fraud.

words.collocation_hint: join the army; the army of; army of workers
words.mnemonics: arm（手臂）+y（谐音“一”），一支手臂组成的军队，联想士兵们团结一致。

words.translation: 安排, 排列, 达成协议；重排
words.example_en: The meeting was arranged for next Monday.
words.example_zh: 会议安排在周一。

defs.text: To set up; to organize; to put into an orderly sequence or arrangement.
To plan; to prepare in advance.
defs.ex: to arrange to meet;   to arrange for supper

defs.text: To prepare and adapt an already-written composition for presentation in other than its original form.

words.exam_meaning: v. 安排, 排列, 达成协议；重排
words.collocation_hint: arrange for; arrange a meeting; arrange to do
words.mnemonics: ar(加强)+range(排列)→把东西排好，就是安排、排列；排好了就达成协议。

words.translation: 逮捕, 监禁；拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
words.example_en: Police arrested the suspect at the airport.
words.example_zh: 警方在机场逮捕了嫌疑人。

defs.text: A check, stop, an act or instance of arresting something.
The condition of being stopped, standstill.
The process of arresting a criminal, suspect etc.

words.exam_meaning: n. 逮捕, 监禁；vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
words.collocation_hint: arrest sb for; under arrest; make an arrest
words.mnemonics: a(加强)+rest(休息)=强制休息，即逮捕；引申为阻止、吸引。

words.translation: 到达, 抵达, 到达者；到达, 到达物
words.example_en: The arrival of the internet changed everything.
words.example_zh: 互联网的到来改变了一切。
words.exam_meaning: n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者；到达, 到达物
words.collocation_hint: on arrival; the arrival of; arrival time
words.mnemonics: arr(来)+ival(名词后缀)，来了就是到达，来的人就是到达者。

words.translation: 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术；实际保持时间, 特许权和资源表, 平均检索时间, 平均运行时间
words.example_en: Modern art challenges our ideas of beauty.
words.example_zh: 现代艺术挑战我们对美的观念。

defs.text: The conscious production or arrangement of sounds, colours, forms, movements, or other elements in a manner that affects the senses and emotions, usually specifically the production of the beautiful in a graphic or plastic medium.
defs.ex: There is a debate as to whether graffiti is art or vandalism.

defs.text: The creative and emotional expression of mental imagery, such as visual, auditory, social, etc.
Skillful creative activity, usually with an aesthetic focus.
defs.ex: She's mastered the art of programming.

words.exam_meaning: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术；实际保持时间, 特许权和资源表, 平均检索时间, 平均运行时间
words.collocation_hint: work of art; art gallery; the art of
words.mnemonics: art=艺术，联想“艺术需要技术，更要巧妙心思”

words.example_en: The main artery of the city was blocked by traffic.
words.example_zh: 城市的主干道被车流堵住了。
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: artery=arter(动脉)+y，联想“动脉是血液的干线”，记住双义。

words.translation: 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约；信件
words.example_en: She wrote an article on climate change.
words.example_zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

defs.text: A piece of nonfictional writing such as a story, report, opinion piece, or entry in a newspaper, magazine, journal, dictionary, encyclopedia, etc.
An object, a member of a group or class.
defs.ex: a sales article

defs.text: (grammar) A part of speech that indicates, specifies and limits a noun (a, an, or the in English). In some languages the article may appear as an ending (e.g. definite article in Swedish) or there may be none (e.g. Russian, Pashto).

words.exam_meaning: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约；信件
words.collocation_hint: write an article; an article on; article of
words.mnemonics: art(艺术)+icle(小东西)=写文章是艺术，文章也是小物品，合同里还有条款。

words.translation: 清楚表达 adj. 善于表达的
words.example_en: She articulated her ideas clearly.
words.example_zh: 她清楚地表达了自己的想法。
words.exam_meaning: v. 清楚表达 adj. 善于表达的
words.collocation_hint: articulate one's views; clearly articulate; articulate the need
words.mnemonics: “阿提”出来说清楚：把话“提”出来，articulate就是表达清晰。

words.example_en: Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.
words.example_zh: 人工智能正在改变许多行业。
words.collocation_hint: artificial intelligence; artificial light; artificial selection
words.mnemonics: arti（艺术）+ficial（做）→ 艺术加工出来的，非天然的，即人造的。

words.example_en: The artist is famous for her landscape paintings.
words.example_zh: 这位艺术家以风景画闻名。

defs.text: A person who creates art.
A person who is skilled at some activity.
A recording artist.

words.collocation_hint: a famous artist; street artist; artist's work
words.mnemonics: art（艺术）+ist（人）=搞艺术的人，就是艺术家。

words.translation: 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
words.example_en: The film shows great artistic value.
words.example_zh: 这部电影具有很高的艺术价值。

defs.text: Having or revealing creative skill.
Relating to or characteristic of art or artists.
Aesthetically pleasing.

words.exam_meaning: a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
words.collocation_hint: artistic value; artistic expression; artistic talent
words.mnemonics: art（艺术）+istic（形容词后缀），有艺术气息的，就是艺术的。

words.example_en: The police failed to ascertain the cause of the fire.
words.example_zh: 警方未能查明火灾原因。
words.collocation_hint: ascertain the cause; ascertain the facts; ascertain whether
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+certain(确定)，加强确定→查明真相。

words.translation: 小声说的话, 旁白；在一边, 离开, 另外
words.example_en: Aside from cost, there are other factors to consider.
words.example_zh: 除了成本,还有其他因素需要考虑。

defs.text: An incidental remark made quietly so as to be heard by the person to whom it is said and not by any others in the vicinity.
A brief comment by a character addressing the audience, unheard by other characters.
A minor related mention, an afterthought.

words.exam_meaning: n. 小声说的话, 旁白；adv. 在一边, 离开, 另外
words.collocation_hint: aside from; set aside; put aside
words.mnemonics: a(向) + side(边) → 向边上靠，即“在一边、离开”

words.translation: 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的；熟睡地
words.example_en: The children fell asleep during the movie.
words.example_zh: 孩子们看电影时睡着了。
words.exam_meaning: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的；adv. 熟睡地
words.collocation_hint: fall asleep; fast asleep; be asleep
words.mnemonics: a(在)+sleep(睡觉)，在睡觉的状态就是睡着的；睡久了手脚发麻，引申为麻木。

words.translation: 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向；方面, 局面; 外观
words.example_en: We must consider every aspect of the problem.
words.example_zh: 我们必须考虑问题的每个方面。

defs.text: Any specific feature, part, or element of something.
defs.ex: Japan's aging population is an important aspect of its economy.

defs.text: The way something appears when viewed from a certain direction or perspective.
The way something appears when considered from a certain point of view.

words.exam_meaning: n. 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向；方面, 局面; 外观
words.collocation_hint: in all aspects; an aspect of; from the aspect of
words.mnemonics: a(一个)+spect(看)，看一个东西的“方面”和“外观”。

words.translation: 攻击, 袭击；袭击, 攻击；发动攻击
words.example_en: The attack was an assault on democratic values.
words.example_zh: 这次攻击是对民主价值观的侵犯。

defs.text: A violent onset or attack with physical means, for example blows, weapons, etc.
defs.ex: to make assault upon a man, a house, or a town

defs.text: A violent onset or attack with moral weapons, for example words, arguments, appeals, and the like
defs.ex: to make an assault on the prerogatives of a prince, or on the constitution of a government

defs.text: An attempt to commit battery: a violent attempt, or willful effort with force or violence, to do hurt to another, but without necessarily touching his person, as by lifting a fist in a threatening manner, or by striking at him and missing him.

words.exam_meaning: n. 攻击, 袭击；vt. 袭击, 攻击；vi. 发动攻击
words.collocation_hint: assault on; sexual assault; assault weapons
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+sault(跳)，跳起来打你，就是袭击。

words.example_en: The workers assembled the parts into a machine.
words.example_zh: 工人们把零件组装成了一台机器。
words.collocation_hint: assemble a team; assemble the parts; be assembled in
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+semble(类似same相同)→使相同的东西聚到一起→集合；把零件按相同规格装起来→组装

words.translation: 主张, 坚称, 断言；宣称, 断言, 维护
words.example_en: The report asserts that the policy has failed.
words.example_zh: 报告断言这项政策失败了。

defs.text: An assertion; a section of source code which tests whether an expected condition is true.
To declare with assurance or plainly and strongly; to state positively.
defs.ex: He would often assert that there was life on other planets.

defs.text: To use or exercise and thereby prove the existence of.
defs.ex: Salman Rushdie has asserted his right to be identified as the author of this work.

words.exam_meaning: vt. 主张, 坚称, 断言；宣称, 断言, 维护
words.collocation_hint: assert that; assert one's rights; confidently assert
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+sert(插入)，把观点强行插入对话，就是断言、维护自己的主张。

words.example_en: The report makes the assertion that prices will rise.
words.example_zh: 报告断言物价将上涨。
words.collocation_hint: assertion that; make an assertion; a bold assertion
words.mnemonics: as(向)+sert(插入)+ion，把观点强硬插入对话中，就是断言主张。

words.example_en: The damage caused by the flood is difficult to assess.
words.example_zh: 洪水造成的损失难以评估。
words.collocation_hint: assess the impact; assess the situation; assess the risk
words.mnemonics: as-加强 + sess坐，坐下来认真评估，像考官坐着打分。

words.example_en: Good communication skills are a valuable asset.
words.example_zh: 良好的沟通技巧是一项宝贵的资产。

defs.text: Something or someone of any value; any portion of one's property or effects so considered.
defs.ex: These shares are a valuable asset.

defs.text: Any component, model, process or framework of value that can be leveraged or reused.
An intelligence asset.

words.exam_meaning: n. 资产, 有益的东西
words.collocation_hint: a valuable asset; financial assets; asset management
words.mnemonics: as（加强）+set（放置）→放在身边有用的东西→资产；对你有益的东西。

words.example_en: The teacher assigned us a difficult task.
words.example_zh: 老师给我们布置了一项困难的任务。
words.collocation_hint: assign a task; assign to; assign responsibility
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+sign(标记)→在任务上做标记→分配、指派任务

words.translation: 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述；赋值
words.example_en: The teacher gave us a difficult assignment.
words.example_zh: 老师给我们布置了困难的任务。

defs.text: The act of assigning; the allocation of a job or a set of tasks.
defs.ex: This flow chart represents the assignment of tasks in our committee.

defs.text: The categorization of something as belonging to a specific category.
defs.ex: We should not condone the assignment of asylum seekers to that of people smugglers.

defs.text: An assigned task.
defs.ex: The assignment the department gave him proved to be quite challenging.

words.exam_meaning: n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述；赋值
words.collocation_hint: assignment of; complete an assignment; writing assignment
words.mnemonics: assign（分配）+ment（名词后缀），分配下来的活儿就是任务和作业。

words.example_en: Immigrants gradually assimilate into the local culture.
words.example_zh: 移民逐渐融入当地文化。
words.collocation_hint: assimilate into; assimilate knowledge; be assimilated
words.mnemonics: as(向)+simil(相同)+ate(使)，使变得相同→同化；吸收知识也像把外来物变成自己的。

words.translation: 帮助, 协助；帮助, 促进；协助, 参加
words.example_en: The program assists students from low-income families.
words.example_zh: 该项目帮助低收入家庭的学生。

defs.text: A helpful action or an act of giving.
defs.ex: The foundation gave a much needed assist to the shelter.

defs.text: The act of helping another player score points or goals
defs.ex: He had two assists in the game.

defs.text: To help.
defs.ex: This book will assist you in getting your life in order.

words.exam_meaning: n. 帮助, 协助；vt. 帮助, 促进；vi. 协助, 参加
words.collocation_hint: assist in; assist with; assist sb to do
words.mnemonics: as(加强)+sist(站)，站在你身边帮你，就是协助。

words.translation: 协助, 援助；援助, 帮助
words.example_en: The government provides financial assistance to small firms.
words.example_zh: 政府向小企业提供财政援助。

defs.text: Aid; help; the act or result of assisting.

words.exam_meaning: n. 协助, 援助；援助, 帮助
words.collocation_hint: provide assistance; financial assistance; come to sb's assistance
words.mnemonics: assist（帮助）+ance（名词后缀）=帮助的行为，联想“阿西吧，需要援助！”

words.translation: 助手, 助理, 助教；有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
words.example_en: She works as a research assistant at the university.
words.example_zh: 她在大学做研究助理。

defs.text: Someone who is present; a bystander, a witness.
A person who assists or helps someone else.
Sales assistant.

words.exam_meaning: n. 助手, 助理, 助教；a. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
words.collocation_hint: research assistant; assistant professor; administrative assistant
words.mnemonics: assist（帮助）+ ant（人）→ 帮助别人的人就是助手。

words.translation: 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物；使联合, 使发生联系；交往
words.example_en: People often associate success with hard work.
words.example_zh: 人们常把成功与勤奋联系在一起。

defs.text: A person united with another or others in an act, enterprise, or business; a partner.
Somebody with whom one works, coworker, colleague.
A companion; a comrade.

words.exam_meaning: n. 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物；vt. 使联合, 使发生联系；vi. 交往

words.example_zh: 计划需要具体措施,而不是空头承诺。

defs.text: A solid mass formed by the coalescence of separate particles; a compound substance, a concretion.
Specifically, a building material created by mixing cement, water, and aggregate such as gravel and sand.
defs.ex: The road was made of concrete that had been poured in large slabs.

defs.text: A term designating both a quality and the subject in which it exists; a concrete term.

words.exam_meaning: n. 凝结物, 混凝土；a. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的；v. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑
words.collocation_hint: concrete measures; concrete example; concrete evidence
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+crete（创造）→共同创造出的实物→具体的、混凝土

words.example_en: The two projects ran concurrently.
words.example_zh: 两个项目同时进行。
words.exam_meaning: adj. 同时发生的；并存的
words.collocation_hint: concurrent with; concurrently, the; concurrent development
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+cur（跑）+rent→一起跑→同时发生

words.translation: 情况, 条件；使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应；条件
words.example_en: The workers are demanding better working conditions.
words.example_zh: 工人们要求更好的工作条件。

defs.text: A logical clause or phrase that a conditional statement uses. The phrase can either be true or false.
A requirement or requisite.
defs.ex: Environmental protection is a condition for sustainability.   What other planets might have the right conditions for life?   The union had a dispute over sick time and other conditions of employment.

defs.text: A clause in a contract or agreement indicating that a certain contingency may modify the principal obligation in some way.

words.collocation_hint: working conditions; on condition that; living conditions
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+dit（说）+ion（名词）→共同说好的东西→条件；由此引申为情况。

words.translation: 行为, 举动, 指导；为人, 指挥, 管理, 实施；领导, 传导, 指挥
words.example_en: The scientists conducted a series of experiments.
words.example_zh: 科学家们进行了一系列实验。

defs.text: The act or method of controlling or directing
Skillful guidance or management; leadership
Behaviour; the manner of behaving
defs.ex: Good conduct will be rewarded and likewise poor conduct will be punished.

words.collocation_hint: conduct research; conduct a survey; code of conduct
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+duct（引导）→引导大家一起做事，即实施、指挥。

words.example_en: The degree confers the right to teach.
words.example_zh: 这个学位赋予任教资格。
words.collocation_hint: confer on; confer a degree; confer with
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+fer（带来）→把意见带来一起商量，或把荣誉带来授予你。

words.translation: 会议；会议, 讨论会, 协商会
words.example_en: She presented her findings at the conference.
words.example_zh: 她在会议上展示了她的研究成果。

defs.text: The act of consulting together formally; serious conversation or discussion; interchange of views.
A multilateral diplomatic negotiation.
A formal event where scientists present their research results in speeches, workshops, posters or by other means.

words.exam_meaning: n. 会议；会议, 讨论会, 协商会
words.collocation_hint: press conference; conference on; attend a conference
words.mnemonics: con（一起）+fer（带来）+ence（名词后缀）→把大家带来一起开会。

words.example_en: The public has lost confidence in the government.
words.example_zh: 公众对政府失去了信心。

defs.text: Self-assurance.
A feeling of certainty; firm trust or belief; faith.
Information held in secret.

words.collocation_hint: confidence in; have confidence; with confidence
words.mnemonics: con-共同 + fid-相信 + -ence名词后缀，共同相信→有信心

words.translation: 有信心的, 有把握的
words.example_en: She is confident of winning the election.
words.example_zh: 她对赢得选举很有信心。

defs.text: A person in whom one can confide or share one's secrets: a friend.
Very sure of something; positive.
defs.ex: I'm pretty confident that she's not lying, she's acting normally.

defs.text: Self-assured, self-reliant, sure of oneself.

words.exam_meaning: a. 有信心的, 有把握的
words.collocation_hint: be confident of; confident that; feel confident
words.mnemonics: con-（共同）+fid（相信）+ent（形容词后缀）→共同相信→有信心

words.translation: 限制；局限 n. 范围
words.example_en: The discussion was confined to the budget.
words.example_zh: 讨论仅限于预算问题。
words.exam_meaning: v. 限制；局限 n. 范围
words.collocation_hint: confine to; be confined to; confine oneself to
words.mnemonics: con（一起）+fine（罚款）→被罚款就得受限制，不能乱来。

words.example_en: The experiment confirmed the scientists' hypothesis.
words.example_zh: 实验证实了科学家的假设。
words.collocation_hint: confirm that; confirm the news; be confirmed as
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+firm（坚定）→共同坚定地认定，即确认、证实。

words.example_en: The conflict between work and family is hard to balance.
words.example_zh: 工作与家庭之间的冲突难以平衡。
words.collocation_hint: conflict between; conflict with; armed conflict
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+flict（打）→一起打→冲突；内心打架→矛盾

words.example_en: Students must conform to the school rules.
words.example_zh: 学生必须遵守学校的规定。
words.collocation_hint: conform to; conform with; conform to the rules
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+form（形状）→和大家形状一样→遵从、符合。

words.example_en: We must confront these difficulties directly.
words.example_zh: 我们必须直接面对这些困难。
words.collocation_hint: confront a challenge; be confronted with; confront the reality
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+front（前面）→共同站到前面→面对，对抗。

words.translation: 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序；含混
words.example_en: The new rules caused confusion among drivers.
words.example_zh: 新规定让司机感到困惑。

defs.text: A lack of clarity or order.
The state of being confused; misunderstanding.
A state of shame or embarrassment.

words.exam_meaning: n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序；含混
words.collocation_hint: confusion about; cause confusion; in confusion
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+fus（流）+ion（名词），所有东西流到一起，就混乱了。

words.example_en: The conglomerate owns businesses in many sectors.
words.example_zh: 这家企业集团在许多行业拥有业务。
words.exam_meaning: n. 企业集团；联合大公司
words.collocation_hint: a media conglomerate; conglomerate of; multinational conglomerate
words.mnemonics: con共同+glomer球+ate→很多小球聚成一大团，即多家公司联合成大集团。

words.translation: 国会, 会议, 讨论会；会议, 会合
words.example_en: Congress passed the new tax bill.
words.example_zh: 国会通过了新税法。

defs.text: A coming together of two or more people; a meeting.
A formal gathering or assembly; a conference held to discuss or decide on a specific question.
(often capitalized: Congress) A legislative body of a state, originally the bicameral legislature of the United States of America.

words.exam_meaning: n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会；会议, 会合
words.collocation_hint: Congress passed; member of Congress; Congress approved
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+gress（走）→大家走到一起开会→国会/会议。

words.translation: 连接, 联合, 联系
words.example_en: The two cities are connected by a high-speed railway.
words.example_zh: 两座城市由高铁相连。

defs.text: (of an object) To join (to another object): to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to another object.
defs.ex: I think this piece connects to that piece over there.

defs.text: (of two objects) To join: to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to each other.
defs.ex: Both roads have the same name, but they don't connect: they're on opposite sides of the river, and there's no bridge there.

defs.text: (of an object) To join (two other objects), or to join (one object) to (another object): to be a link between two objects, thereby attaching them to each other.
defs.ex: The new railroad will connect the northern part of the state to the southern part.

words.exam_meaning: v. 连接, 联合, 联系
words.collocation_hint: connect with; be connected to; connect A to B
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+nect（绑），把东西绑在一起就是连接，人和人绑在一起就是联系。

words.translation: 连接, 关系, 前后关系；连接
words.example_en: There is a clear connection between diet and health.
words.example_zh: 饮食与健康之间有明显联系。

defs.text: The act of connecting.
The point at which two or more things are connected.
defs.ex: My headache has no connection with me going out last night.

defs.text: A feeling of understanding and ease of communication between two or more people.
defs.ex: As we were the only people in the room to laugh at the joke, I felt a connection between us.

words.exam_meaning: n. 连接, 关系, 前后关系；连接
words.collocation_hint: connection between; in connection with; have connections
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+nect（绑）+ion（名词后缀）→绑在一起→连接、关系。

words.example_en: The word has negative connotations.
words.example_zh: 这个词有负面含义。
words.collocation_hint: connotation of; negative connotations; cultural connotations
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+not（标记）+ation→共同标记出的深层意思，即内涵

words.example_en: She was conscious of being watched.
words.example_zh: 她意识到有人在注视她。
words.collocation_hint: be conscious of; conscious decision; become conscious
confusable_words: conscious / conscience — conscious 是'有意识的'(be conscious of),conscience 是'良心'(a clear conscience)
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+ sci（知道）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ 共同知道 → 有意识的；故意做就是有意识去做。

words.example_en: The team won three consecutive games.
words.example_zh: 球队连续赢了三场比赛。
words.collocation_hint: consecutive years; three consecutive; for the fifth consecutive
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+secu（跟随）+tive，一个跟着一个，就是连续的。

words.example_en: The committee finally reached a consensus on the issue.
words.example_zh: 委员会最终就该问题达成共识。
words.collocation_hint: reach a consensus; consensus on; general consensus
words.mnemonics: con共同+sens感觉+us我们→我们感觉相同→共识

words.example_en: The patients gave their consent to the treatment.
words.example_zh: 病人同意接受治疗。
words.collocation_hint: consent to; give consent; with the consent of
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+sent（感觉）→ 有共同感觉 → 同意

words.example_en: He must face the consequences of his actions.
words.example_zh: 他必须面对自己行为的后果。
words.collocation_hint: as a consequence; in consequence of; the consequences of
words.mnemonics: con(共同)+sequ(跟随)+ence→跟随而来的东西→后果

words.example_en: The project promotes the conservation of water.
words.example_zh: 该项目促进节约用水。

defs.text: The act of preserving, guarding, or protecting; the keeping (of a thing) in a safe or entire state; preservation.
Wise use of natural resources.
The discipline concerned with protection of biodiversity, the environment, and natural resources

words.exam_meaning: n. 保护, 保存；保存
words.collocation_hint: conservation of; energy conservation; wildlife conservation
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+serv（保持）+ation，共同保持资源，即保护、保存。

words.translation: 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的；防腐剂; 保存剂
words.example_en: The conservative party won the election.
words.example_zh: 保守党赢得了选举。

defs.text: A person who favors maintenance of the status quo.
Cautious.
Tending to resist change or innovation.
defs.ex: The curriculum committee at this university is extremely conservative.

words.exam_meaning: a. 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的；防腐剂; 保存剂
words.collocation_hint: conservative estimate; conservative approach; conservative party
words.mnemonics: con(全部)+serv(保持)+ative(形容词后缀)→全都保持原样，就是保守的。

words.translation: 考虑, 思考, 认为
words.example_en: We should consider all the options before deciding.
words.example_zh: 在做决定前我们应该考虑所有选项。

defs.text: To think about seriously.
defs.ex: Consider that we’ve had three major events and the year has hardly begun.

defs.text: To think about something seriously or carefully: to deliberate.
To think of doing.
defs.ex: I’m considering going to the beach tomorrow.

words.exam_meaning: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为
words.collocation_hint: consider doing; be considered as; consider the possibility
words.mnemonics: con(共同)+sider(星星)，一起看星星时思考人生，即考虑、认为。

words.translation: 相当的, 可观的, 重要的
words.example_en: The project requires a considerable amount of money.
words.example_zh: 这个项目需要大量资金。

defs.text: A thing to be considered, consideration.
Significant; worth considering.
defs.ex: I've spent a considerable amount of time on this.

defs.text: Large in amount.

words.exam_meaning: a. 相当的, 可观的, 重要的
words.collocation_hint: considerable amount; considerable attention; considerable progress
confusable_words: considerable / considerate — considerable 是'相当大的'(considerable effort),considerate 是'体贴的'(considerate of others)
words.mnemonics: con(共同)+sider(坐)+able(能)→能一起坐下来谈的，说明事情重要、规模可观。

words.translation: 考虑, 原因；考虑, 思考, 报酬
words.example_en: The proposal is under consideration.
words.example_zh: 这项提议正在审议中。
words.exam_meaning: n. 考虑, 原因；考虑, 思考, 报酬
words.collocation_hint: take into consideration; under consideration; consideration for
words.mnemonics: con(共同)+sider(星)+ation，一起看星星时，要“考虑”对方的感受，还要给“报酬”吗？

words.translation: 组成, 存在于, 一致
words.example_en: The committee consists of twelve members.
words.example_zh: 委员会由十二名成员组成。

defs.text: To be.
To exist.
(with in) To be comprised or contained.

words.exam_meaning: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
words.collocation_hint: consist of; consist in; consist with
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+sist（站）=站在一起，即组成、一致。

words.example_en: The results show consistency across the studies.
words.example_zh: 各项研究的结果具有一致性。
words.collocation_hint: consistency of; consistency in; internal consistency
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+sist（站立）+ency（名词后缀）→大家站在一起，保持一致。

words.translation: 一致的, 坚持的, 并立的, 坚固的
words.example_en: His actions are not consistent with his words.
words.example_zh: 他的行为与他的言辞不一致。

defs.text: (in the plural) Objects or facts that are coexistent, or in agreement with one another.
A kind of penitent who was allowed to assist at prayers, but was not permitted to receive the holy sacraments.
Of a regularly occurring, dependable nature.
defs.ex: He is very consistent in his political choices: economy good or bad, he always votes Labour!

words.exam_meaning: a. 一致的, 坚持的, 并立的, 坚固的
words.collocation_hint: be consistent with; consistent policy; remain consistent
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+sist（站立）+ent（形容词）→ 大家站在一起，立场一致，坚持不变。

words.example_en: The company consolidated its position in the market.
words.example_zh: 公司巩固了市场地位。
words.collocation_hint: consolidate the position; consolidate power; be consolidated
words.mnemonics: con共同+solid坚固+ate动词后缀，共同使坚固=巩固；使合成坚固整体=合并。

words.translation: 常数, 恒量；不变的, 一定的, 时常的；常量; 常数; 恒值
words.example_en: The machine requires constant maintenance.
words.example_zh: 这台机器需要持续维护。
words.exam_meaning: n. 常数, 恒量；a. 不变的, 一定的, 时常的；常量; 常数; 恒值
words.collocation_hint: constant attention; constant change; constant pressure
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+stant（站）=一直站着不动，所以是“不变的、持续的”。

words.example_en: Women constitute half of the workforce.
words.example_zh: 女性占劳动力的一半。
words.collocation_hint: constitute a threat; be constituted by; constitute part of
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+stitute（站立）→共同站立在一起→构成整体。

words.example_en: He has a strong constitution, so he should make a quick recovery from the illness.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+stitut（建立）+ion（名词后缀）→共同建立起来的根本法则→宪法；也指事物的构成方式。

words.example_en: Trust is a constitutive element of the relationship.
words.example_zh: 信任是这种关系的构成要素。
words.collocation_hint: constitutive element; constitutive of; a constitutive role
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+stitut（建立）+ive（形容词后缀）→共同建立起来的→构成的

words.example_en: The budget constrains the scale of the project.
words.example_zh: 预算限制了项目的规模。
words.collocation_hint: be constrained by; constrain the development; financial constraints
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+ strain（拉紧）→ 一起拉紧，限制住你。

words.translation: 构造, 建造, 对...进行构思, 作图；构成物
words.example_en: The bridge was constructed in the nineteenth century.
words.example_zh: 这座桥建于十九世纪。

defs.text: Something constructed from parts.
defs.ex: Loops and conditional statements are constructs in computer programming.

defs.text: A concept or model.
defs.ex: Bohr's theoretical construct of the atom was soon superseded by quantum mechanics.

defs.text: (genetics) A segment of nucleic acid, created artificially, for transplantation into a target cell or tissue.

words.exam_meaning: vt. 构造, 建造, 对...进行构思, 作图；n. 构成物
words.collocation_hint: construct a building; be constructed of; construct a theory
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+struct（建造）→共同建造→建造；引申为构思。

words.translation: 建筑, 构造, 建筑物；施工
words.example_en: The construction of the new airport will take three years.
words.example_zh: 新机场的建设将耗时三年。

defs.text: The process of constructing.
defs.ex: Construction is underway on the new bridge.

defs.text: Anything that has been constructed.
defs.ex: The engineer marvelled at his construction.

defs.text: The trade of building structures.
defs.ex: He had worked in construction all his life.

words.exam_meaning: n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物；施工
words.collocation_hint: under construction; construction industry; construction of
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+struct（建造）+ion（名词后缀）→共同建造→建筑、施工。

words.translation: 顾问, 征询意见者；顾问医师
words.example_en: She works as a management consultant.
words.example_zh: 她是一名管理顾问。
words.exam_meaning: n. 顾问, 征询意见者；顾问医师
words.collocation_hint: management consultant; consultant on; a consultant to
words.mnemonics: con-共同+sult-跳+ant人，一起跳出来给你出主意的人就是顾问。

words.translation: 消耗, 消费, 消灭；耗尽, 毁灭
words.example_en: The car consumes a lot of fuel.
words.example_zh: 这辆车耗油量大。

defs.text: To use up.
defs.ex: The power plant consumes 30 tons of coal per hour.

defs.text: To eat.
defs.ex: Baby birds consume their own weight in food each day.

defs.text: To completely occupy the thoughts or attention of.
defs.ex: Desire consumed him.

words.collocation_hint: consume energy; consume time; be consumed by
words.mnemonics: con（全部）+ sum（拿取）+ e，把东西全部拿走，就是消耗、消费。

words.example_en: Consumer confidence is falling.
words.example_zh: 消费者信心正在下降。
words.collocation_hint: consumer confidence; consumer spending; consumer goods
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+sum（拿取）+er（人），共同拿取商品的人就是消费者。

words.translation: 消费, 消费量, 痨病；消耗量; 耗量
words.example_en: Energy consumption has risen sharply.
words.example_zh: 能源消耗急剧上升。

defs.text: The act of eating, drinking or using.
defs.ex: The consumption of snails as food is more common in France than in England.

defs.text: The amount consumed.
defs.ex: gross national consumption

defs.text: The act of consuming or destroying.
defs.ex: The fire's consumption of the forest caused ecological changes.

words.exam_meaning: n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病；消耗量; 耗量
words.collocation_hint: consumption of; energy consumption; reduce consumption
words.mnemonics: con(共同)+sum(拿取)+ption→大家共同拿取→消费；消耗量。

words.translation: 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触；接触, 联系；使接触
words.example_en: Please contact us if you have any questions.
words.example_zh: 如有任何问题,请联系我们。

defs.text: The act of touching physically; being in close association.
The establishment of communication (with).
defs.ex: I haven't been in contact with her for years.

defs.text: A nodule designed to connect a device with something else.
defs.ex: Touch the contact to ground and read the number again.

words.exam_meaning: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触；vi. 接触, 联系；vt. 使接触
words.collocation_hint: contact with; in contact with; make contact with
words.mnemonics: con（共同）+tact（触摸）→共同触摸到→接触、联系。

words.translation: 包含, 容纳, 控制；自制
words.example_en: The report contains a number of errors.
words.example_zh: 这份报告包含多处错误。

defs.text: To hold inside.
To include as a part.
To put constraint upon; to restrain; to confine; to keep within bounds.
defs.ex: I'm so excited, I can hardly contain myself!

words.exam_meaning: vt. 包含, 容纳, 控制；vi. 自制

defs.text: (often capitalized) The personification of death as a hooded figure with a scythe; the Grim Reaper. The pronoun he is not the only option, but probably the most traditional one, as it matches with the male grammatical gender of Old English dēaþ, also with cognate German der Tod. The fourth apocalyptic rider (Bible, revelations 6:8) is male θᾰ́νᾰτος (thanatos) in Greek. It has the female name Mors in Latin, but is referred to with male forms qui and eum. The following quotes show this rider on a pale horse is his in the English Bible and she in Peter Gabriel's lyrics.

words.translation: 雇用, 职业, 工作；职业, 雇用, 职工招请
words.example_en: The new factory will provide employment for hundreds of local workers.
words.example_zh: 新工厂将为数百名本地工人提供就业。

The act of employing
A use, purpose

words.exam_meaning: n. 雇用, 职业, 工作；职业, 雇用, 职工招请
words.collocation_hint: employment opportunities; full employment; employment rate
words.mnemonics: em(进入)+ploy(折叠)+ment(名词后缀)→被折叠进公司里→雇用、工作。

words.example_en: Education empowers people to change their lives.
words.example_zh: 教育赋予人们改变生活的能力。
words.collocation_hint: empower sb to do; empower women; be empowered to
words.mnemonics: em（使）+power（权力）→使有权力，即授权；引申为使有能力。

words.example_en: The program aims at the economic empowerment of women.
words.example_zh: 该项目旨在增强妇女的经济能力。
words.mnemonics: em（使）+power（权力）+ment（名词后缀）→ 使人拥有权力，即赋权。

words.translation: 使能够；允许, 使能, 打开
words.example_en: The new technology enables people to work from home.
words.example_zh: 新技术使人们能够在家工作。

defs.text: To make somebody able (to do, or to be, something); to give sufficient ability or power to do or to be; to give strength or ability to.
To affirm; to make firm and strong.
To qualify or approve for some role or position; to render sanction or authorization to; to confirm suitability for.

words.exam_meaning: vt. 使能够；允许, 使能, 打开
words.collocation_hint: enable sb to do; enable the use of; make it possible to
words.mnemonics: en-使 + able能够 → 使能够，让事情变得可能。

words.example_en: This book on English grammar encompasses all irregular verbs.
words.mnemonics: en（使）+ compass（罗盘）→ 用罗盘圈定范围 → 包含、涵盖。

words.example_en: We encountered some difficulties.
words.example_zh: 我们遇到了一些困难。
words.collocation_hint: encounter difficulties; encounter problems; a chance encounter
words.mnemonics: en(使)+counter(柜台)，在柜台前碰到熟人，就是遇到。

words.translation: 鼓励, 支持, 激励；怂恿, 煽动, 助长
words.example_en: The teacher encouraged her students to ask questions.
words.example_zh: 老师鼓励学生提问。

defs.text: To mentally support; to motivate, give courage, hope or spirit.
defs.ex: I encouraged him during his race.

defs.text: To spur on, strongly recommend.
defs.ex: We encourage the use of bicycles in the town centre.

defs.text: To foster, give help or patronage
defs.ex: The royal family has always encouraged the arts in word and deed

words.exam_meaning: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励；怂恿, 煽动, 助长
words.collocation_hint: encourage sb to do; encourage the development of; strongly encourage
words.mnemonics: en(使)+courage(勇气)→使有勇气→鼓励。

words.example_en: The data is protected by encryption.
words.example_zh: 数据受到加密保护。
words.collocation_hint: encryption of; data encryption; encryption technology
words.mnemonics: en-使 + crypt-隐藏 + -ion名词，使信息隐藏起来，即加密。

words.example_en: The panda is one of the world's most endangered species.
words.example_zh: 大熊猫是世界上最濒危的物种之一。
words.mnemonics: en(使)+danger(危险)+ed→使处于危险中→濒危的，如 endangered species 濒危物种。

words.example_en: The university was endowed with a large donation.
words.example_zh: 这所大学获得了一笔巨额捐赠。
words.mnemonics: en(使)+dow(给)→使给予，即赋予；把钱给出去就是捐赠。

words.example_en: He endured the pain in silence.
words.example_zh: 他默默忍受着痛苦。
words.collocation_hint: endure hardship; endure the pain; long-lasting
words.mnemonics: en（使）+dure（持续）→使持续下去，即忍受、持久。

words.example_en: The singer's popularity endured for decades.
words.mnemonics: en(使)+dur(持续)+ing，使一直持续下去，就是持久的。

words.translation: 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军；敌人的
words.example_en: The two countries were enemies during the war.
words.example_zh: 两国在战争期间是敌国。
words.exam_meaning: n. 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军；a. 敌人的
words.collocation_hint: enemy of; make enemies; enemy forces
words.mnemonics: en-（使）+emy（谐音‘挨米’），敌人让你挨打，记住‘敌人’。

words.translation: 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量；能; 能量
words.example_en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper.
words.example_zh: 可再生能源正变得越来越便宜。

defs.text: The impetus behind all motion and all activity.
The capacity to do work.
A quantity that denotes the ability to do work and is measured in a unit dimensioned in mass × distance²/time² (ML²/T²) or the equivalent.

words.exam_meaning: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量；能; 能量
words.collocation_hint: renewable energy; energy consumption; energy crisis
words.mnemonics: en(使)+erg(工作)+y，使能工作的东西就是能量，人靠能量才有精力干活。

words.translation: 答应, 从事, 交战；使忙碌, 雇佣, 预定, 使从事于, 使参加
words.example_en: The company engages in trade with many countries.
words.example_zh: 这家公司与许多国家进行贸易。

defs.text: (heading) To interact socially.
(heading) To interact antagonistically.
(heading) To interact contractually.

words.collocation_hint: engage in; be engaged in; engage with

words.translation: 引擎, 发动机, 机车；安装发动机于
words.example_en: The engine of the car needs repair.
words.example_zh: 汽车发动机需要修理。

defs.text: A large construction used in warfare, such as a battering ram, catapult etc.
A tool; a utensil or implement.
A complex mechanical device which converts energy into useful motion or physical effects.

words.exam_meaning: n. 引擎, 发动机, 机车；vt. 安装发动机于
words.collocation_hint: engine of; search engine; diesel engine
words.mnemonics: 谐音“引擎”，发动机就是引擎，联想汽车引擎轰鸣发动。

words.translation: 工程师, 工兵；设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
words.example_en: The engineer designed a new bridge.
words.example_zh: 工程师设计了一座新桥。
words.collocation_hint: software engineer; chief engineer; engineer a solution
words.mnemonics: engine（引擎）+eer（人）= 造引擎的人，即工程师；引申为设计、策划。

words.translation: 工程学, 工程, 操纵；机器; 机器学

words.example_zh: 她拥有工程学学位。
words.exam_meaning: n. 工程学, 工程, 操纵；机器; 机器学

words.mnemonics: 英格利希，就是英语；联想“英”国人的“语”言，即英语。

words.mnemonics: en-使+han高→使变高，即提高、增强。

words.example_en: The project has enormous potential.
words.example_zh: 这个项目潜力巨大。

defs.text: Deviating from the norm; unusual, extraordinary.
Exceedingly wicked; atrocious or outrageous.
Extremely large; greatly exceeding the common size, extent, etc.

words.exam_meaning: a. 巨大的, 庞大的
words.collocation_hint: enormous pressure; enormous potential; an enormous amount of
words.mnemonics: e(出)+norm(标准)+ous(形容词后缀)→超出标准的→巨大的

words.example_en: Enrollment in online courses has increased sharply.
words.example_zh: 在线课程的注册人数急剧增加。
words.mnemonics: en(使)+roll(名单)+ment(名词后缀)，使进入名单=登记入学。

words.example_en: The company ensures the quality of its products.
words.example_zh: 公司确保产品质量。
words.collocation_hint: ensure that; ensure the safety of; ensure the quality
confusable_words: ensure / assure / insure — ensure 是'确保',assure 是'使确信/向…保证',insure 是'投保
words.mnemonics: en-使 + sure确定，使确定下来就是确保。

words.example_en: This activity will entail careful attention to detail.
words.mnemonics: en(使)+tail(尾巴)→做事要带尾巴，即牵涉到后续责任，需要承担。

words.translation: 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车；进去, 参加；输入, 回车

words.example_zh: 她在最后一刻参加了比赛。

defs.text: The "Enter" key on a computer keyboard.
A stroke of the Enter key.
To go or come into an enclosed or partially enclosed space.

words.collocation_hint: enter into; enter the market; enter a competition
words.mnemonics: en(使)+ter(走)→走进来，即进入；走进队伍→参加。

words.translation: 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业；企业

words.example_zh: 政府支持中小企业。

defs.text: A company, business, organization, or other purposeful endeavor.

defs.text: An undertaking, venture, or project, especially a daring and courageous one.
defs.ex: Biosphere 2 was a scientific enterprise aimed at the exploration of the complex web of interactions within life systems.

words.collocation_hint: enterprise of; private enterprise; state-owned enterprise

words.translation: 娱乐, 款待, 娱乐表演
words.example_en: The city offers plenty of entertainment.
words.example_zh: 这座城市提供丰富的娱乐活动。

words.translation: 整个, 全部；全体的, 完全的, 全部的

words.example_zh: 整个城市都受到洪水影响。

words.exam_meaning: n. 整个, 全部；a. 全体的, 完全的, 全部的
words.collocation_hint: the entire population; entire process; entire world
words.mnemonics: en（进入）+tire（轮胎）→整个轮胎都进去了，就是“整个的”。

words.translation: 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任；使出神, 使入迷；入口
words.example_en: The entrance to the museum is on the left.
words.example_zh: 博物馆入口在左边。

defs.text: The action of entering, or going in.

defs.text: The act of taking possession, as of property, or of office.
defs.ex: the entrance of an heir upon his inheritance, or of a magistrate into office

defs.ex: Place your bag by the entrance so that you can find it easily.

words.exam_meaning: n. 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任；vt. 使出神, 使入迷；入口
words.collocation_hint: entrance to; at the entrance; entrance fee
words.mnemonics: en(使)+trance(恍惚)，进入入口时使人恍惚，联想入学时紧张又入迷。

words.example_zh: 这位企业家创办了三家公司。

words.mnemonics: enter（进入）+ preneur（取），进入市场取机会的人就是企业家。

words.example_zh: 大学鼓励学生的创业思维。
words.mnemonics: entre(进入)+preneur(拿)+ial，进入市场拿机会，就是创业的。

words.translation: 登录, 条目, 进入, 入口, 报关；登录项, 输入项, 条目

words.example_zh: 周日免费进入博物馆。

words.exam_meaning: n. 登录, 条目, 进入, 入口, 报关；登录项, 输入项, 条目

words.translation: 环境, 外界, 围绕；环境

words.example_zh: 公司致力于保护环境。

defs.text: The surroundings of, and influences on, a particular item of interest.
The natural world or ecosystem.
All the elements that affect a system or its inputs and outputs.

words.collocation_hint: environment protection; working environment; the natural environment

words.example_zh: 环境污染是沿海城市的一大关切。
words.mnemonics: environ（包围）+ment（名词后缀）+al（形容词后缀），被自然包围的→环境的。

words.example_zh: 这次会晤是谈判中的关键一幕。

words.translation: 对手, 匹敌, 同辈；相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的；等于, 比得上
words.example_en: All citizens are equal before the law.
words.example_zh: 法律面前人人平等。

defs.text: A person or thing of equal status to others.
defs.ex: This beer has no equal.

defs.text: State of being equal; equality.

defs.ex: Two plus two equals four.

words.exam_meaning: n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈；a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的；vt. 等于, 比得上
words.collocation_hint: equal to; equal opportunity; be equal in
words.mnemonics: equ(相等)+al(形容词后缀)=相等的；动词引申为“等于、比得上”。

words.example_zh: 法律保障所有公民机会平等。
words.mnemonics: equ（相等）+ality（名词后缀）→ 相等状态，即平等。

words.translation: 装备, 设备, 才能；设备; 装备; 装置

words.example_zh: 实验室配备了现代化设备。

Whatever is used in equipping something or someone, for example things needed for an expedition or voyage.

words.exam_meaning: n. 装备, 设备, 才能；设备; 装备; 装置
words.collocation_hint: a piece of equipment; laboratory equipment; sports equipment
words.mnemonics: equi(相等)+ment(名词后缀)，让能力相等的工具就是设备。

words.example_en: The government promised greater equity in education.
words.example_zh: 政府承诺实现更大的教育公平。
words.collocation_hint: equity in; social equity; gender equity
words.mnemonics: equ（相等）+ity（名词后缀）→ 人人相等，即公平。

words.translation: 等价的 n. 等价物

words.exam_meaning: adj. 等价的 n. 等价物
words.mnemonics: equi（相等）+val（价值）+ent→价值相等，即等价。

words.translation: 时代, 纪元, 时期
words.example_en: The internet marked the beginning of a new era.
words.example_zh: 互联网标志着一个新时代的开始。

defs.text: A time period of indeterminate length, generally more than one year.
A unit of time, smaller than eons and greater than periods.

words.exam_meaning: n. 时代, 纪元, 时期
words.collocation_hint: era of; a new era; the digital era
words.mnemonics: era=er(耳)+a(啊)，耳朵听到新纪元，感叹“啊，新时代来了！”

words.example_en: Smallpox was globally eradicated in 1980.
words.mnemonics: e(出)+radic(根)+ate(动词后缀)，把根拔出来，即根除。

words.translation: 错误, 过失, 失误, 误差；错误
words.example_en: The report contains several errors.
words.example_zh: 这份报告有几处错误。
words.exam_meaning: n. 错误, 过失, 失误, 误差；错误
words.collocation_hint: make an error; error in; trial and error
words.mnemonics: err（犯错）+or（名词后缀）→ 错误。联想：犯错（err）是人的常态。

words.translation: 逃亡, 避难设备, 逃跑；逃脱, 避开, 溜走；逃避, 避免, 被...忘掉
words.example_en: He escaped from the prison at night.
words.example_zh: 他夜间从监狱逃走。

defs.text: The act of leaving a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

defs.text: Leakage or outflow, as of steam or a liquid, or an electric current through defective insulation.
Something that has escaped; an escapee.

words.exam_meaning: n. 逃亡, 避难设备, 逃跑；vi. 逃脱, 避开, 溜走；vt. 逃避, 避免, 被...忘掉
words.collocation_hint: escape from; escape the attention of; narrow escape
words.mnemonics: es(向外)+cape(斗篷)，披上斗篷向外溜走，就是逃跑。

words.translation: 尤其, 特别, 格外

words.example_zh: 食物很好,尤其是海鲜。

defs.text: (manner) In a special manner; specially.
(focus) Particularly; to a greater extent than is normal.
(focus) Used to place greater emphasis upon someone or something.
defs.ex: Invite them all, especially Molly.

words.exam_meaning: adv. 尤其, 特别, 格外
words.collocation_hint: especially when; especially for; especially in

words.mnemonics: e(出)+special(特别的)+ly，特别突出的那个，就是尤其。

words.translation: 随笔, 短文, 评论, 企图；试图

words.example_zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

An attempt.

words.exam_meaning: n. 随笔, 短文, 评论, 企图；vt. 试图
words.collocation_hint: essay on; write an essay; an essay about

words.example_zh: 清洁用水对生命至关重要。
words.collocation_hint: be essential to; essential for; essential skills
words.mnemonics: es(向外)+sent(送)+ial(形容词后缀)，送出去的东西是本质必需的，缺了不行。

words.example_zh: 公司成立于1995年。
words.collocation_hint: establish a system; establish links; be established in

words.translation: 确立, 制定, 设施；企业, 公司, 商店

words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + plain-平白，把事说平白=解释清楚。

words.translation: 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明；解释, 注释, 说明
words.example_en: He gave no explanation for his absence.
words.example_zh: 他没有解释缺席的原因。
words.exam_meaning: n. 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明；解释, 注释, 说明
words.collocation_hint: explanation for; provide an explanation; a reasonable explanation
words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + plain-平 + -ation名词后缀，把事理摊平讲出来就是解释。

words.example_en: The instructions were explicit and easy to follow.
words.example_zh: 说明很明确,容易遵循。
words.collocation_hint: explicit instructions; be explicit about; explicit content
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+plic（折叠）+it，把话向外摊开，不藏着掖着，就是明确直白。

words.translation: 爆炸, 爆发, 激增；使爆炸
words.example_en: The bomb exploded in the city center.
words.example_zh: 炸弹在市中心爆炸。

defs.text: To destroy with an explosion.
defs.ex: The assassin exploded the car by means of a car bomb.

defs.text: To destroy violently or abruptly.
defs.ex: They sought to explode the myth.

defs.text: To create an exploded view of.
defs.ex: Explode the assembly drawing so that all the fasteners are visible.

words.exam_meaning: vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增；vt. 使爆炸
words.collocation_hint: explode with anger; explode into; the population exploded
words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + plode拍手→向外拍手炸开，像气球爆了，也指情绪爆发、数量激增。

words.example_en: We must exploit this opportunity.
words.example_zh: 我们必须利用这个机会。
words.collocation_hint: exploit resources · exploit an opportunity · exploit workers
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+ ploit（折叠）→向外折取别人的价值→利用、剥削。

words.translation: 探险, 探测, 探究
words.example_en: The report explores the causes of the crisis.
words.example_zh: 报告探讨了危机的成因。

defs.text: An exploration; a tour of a place to see what it is like.
To seek for something or after someone.
To examine or investigate something systematically.
defs.ex: The committee has been exploring alternative solutions to the problem at hand.

words.exam_meaning: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
words.collocation_hint: explore the possibility; explore ways; explore in depth
words.mnemonics: ex向外+plore哭喊，向外哭喊寻找，即探索未知。

words.translation: 爆发, 激增, 爆炸(声)；爆炸
words.example_en: The explosion was heard miles away.
words.example_zh: 几英里外都能听到爆炸声。

defs.text: A violent release of energy (sometimes mechanical, nuclear, or chemical.)
A bursting due to pressure.
The sound of an explosion.

words.exam_meaning: n. 爆发, 激增, 爆炸(声)；爆炸
words.collocation_hint: explosion of; population explosion; a huge explosion
words.mnemonics: ex(向外)+plos(爆炸)+ion(名词后缀)，向外炸开，引申为激增、爆发。

words.example_en: Oil is the main export of Saudi Arabia.
words.exam_meaning: v. 出口 n. 出口品
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+ port（港口）→货物从港口向外运出，即出口。

words.example_en: Children should not be exposed to violence.
words.example_zh: 儿童不应接触暴力。
words.collocation_hint: be exposed to; expose the truth; expose to risk
words.mnemonics: ex(向外)+pose(放置)=放到外面，即暴露；把真相放到外面，即揭露。

words.translation: 暴露, 揭发, 揭露；曝光量; 照射; 照射量
words.example_en: Long exposure to the sun damages the skin.
words.example_zh: 长时间日晒会损害皮肤。

defs.text: The condition of being exposed, uncovered, or unprotected.
defs.ex: Limit your exposure to harsh chemicals.   Get as much exposure to a new language as you can.

defs.text: Lack of protection from weather or the elements.
The act of exposing something, such as a scandal.

words.exam_meaning: n. 暴露, 揭发, 揭露；曝光量; 照射; 照射量
words.collocation_hint: exposure to; media exposure; radiation exposure
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+ pos（放）+ ure（名词后缀）→ 放到外面 → 暴露、曝光。

words.translation: 快车, 快递, 专使；明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的；表达, 表示, 表露
words.example_en: She expressed her views clearly.
words.example_zh: 她清楚地表达了自己的观点。

defs.text: A mode of transportation, often a train, that travels quickly or directly.
defs.ex: I took the express into town.

defs.text: A service that allows mail or money to be sent rapidly from one destination to another.
An express rifle.

words.exam_meaning: n. 快车, 快递, 专使；a. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的；vt. 表达, 表示, 表露
words.collocation_hint: express one's views; express concern; express an opinion
words.mnemonics: ex(向外)+press(压)=把想法压出来，即表达；压得准=明确；压得快=快递。

words.translation: 表达, 表现, 词语, 措辞；表达式
words.example_en: The expression on her face showed surprise.
words.example_zh: 她脸上的表情显示出惊讶。

defs.text: The action of expressing thoughts, ideas, feelings, etc.
A particular way of phrasing an idea.
A colloquialism or idiom.
defs.ex: The expression "break a leg!" should not be taken literally.

words.exam_meaning: n. 表达, 表现, 词语, 措辞；表达式
words.collocation_hint: expression of; facial expression; freedom of expression
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+press（压）+ion（名词后缀）→把想法压出来→表达；表现出的样子→词语。

words.translation: 扩充, 延伸, 伸展, 扩大；扩展
words.example_en: The company extended its business to Asia.
words.example_zh: 公司把业务扩展到了亚洲。

defs.text: To increase in extent.
To possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space.
defs.ex: The desert extended for miles in all directions.

defs.text: To cause to increase in extent.

words.collocation_hint: extend the deadline; extend to; extend a hand
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+ tend（伸展）→向外伸展，即延伸、扩展。

words.translation: 延长, 扩充, 范围, 扩展名；伸缩的；扩展名, 扩充名
words.example_en: The university opened an extension of the campus.
words.example_zh: 大学开设了一个新校区。
words.exam_meaning: n. 延长, 扩充, 范围, 扩展名；a. 伸缩的；扩展名, 扩充名
words.collocation_hint: extension of; an extension to; file extension
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+ tens（伸展）+ ion（名词后缀）→向外伸展→延长、扩充。

words.translation: 广的, 广泛的, 多方面的；广大的, 扩大的
words.example_en: The library has an extensive collection of books.
words.example_zh: 图书馆藏书丰富。

defs.text: Having a great extent; covering a large area; vast
Considerable in amount.
defs.ex: I have done extensive research on the subject.

defs.text: Serving to extend or lengthen; characterized by extension

words.exam_meaning: a. 广的, 广泛的, 多方面的；广大的, 扩大的
words.collocation_hint: extensive research; extensive experience; extensive damage
words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + tens-伸展 + -ive形容词后缀，向外伸展出去，就是范围很广。

words.translation: 范围, 程度, 区域；范围
words.example_en: To some extent, the criticism is fair.
words.example_zh: 在某种程度上,批评是公平的。

defs.text: A range of values or locations.
The space, area, volume, etc., to which something extends.
defs.ex: The extent of his knowledge of the language is a few scattered words.

defs.text: A contiguous area of storage in a file system.

words.exam_meaning: n. 范围, 程度, 区域；范围
words.collocation_hint: to some extent; the extent of; to a large extent
words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + tent伸展，向外伸展到多远就是程度和范围。

words.translation: 外部, 外面；外部的, 客观的, 表面的
words.example_en: The building needs external repairs.
words.example_zh: 这栋建筑需要外部修缮。

defs.text: (chiefly in the plural) The exterior; outward features or appearances.
In the C programming language, a variable that is defined in the source code but whose value comes from some external source.
Outside of something; on the exterior.
defs.ex: This building has some external pipework.

words.exam_meaning: n. 外部, 外面；a. 外部的, 客观的, 表面的
words.collocation_hint: external factors; external pressure; external trade
words.mnemonics: ex-向外 + -ternal 看作“turn”，向外转的就是外部的。

words.example_en: Many species are on the edge of extinction.
words.example_zh: 许多物种正处于灭绝的边缘。
words.mnemonics: ex(向外)+tinct(刺、熄灭)+ion，刺向外面→生命之火熄灭→灭绝

words.translation: 额外的事物, 另外的收费；额外的, 特别的；额外地, 特别地, 非常地
words.example_en: The hotel charges extra for breakfast.
words.example_zh: 酒店对早餐额外收费。
words.exam_meaning: n. 额外的事物, 另外的收费；a. 额外的, 特别的；adv. 额外地, 特别地, 非常地
words.collocation_hint: extra cost; extra time; extra attention
words.mnemonics: extra像“额外”，extra-前缀表示“超出”，超出常规就是额外、特别。

words.translation: 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的；非常的, 特别的, 临时的
words.example_en: She showed extraordinary courage in the crisis.
words.example_zh: 她在危机中表现出非凡的勇气。

defs.text: Anything that goes beyond what is ordinary.
Not ordinary; exceptional; unusual.
Remarkably good.
defs.ex: an extraordinary poet

words.exam_meaning: a. 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的；非常的, 特别的, 临时的
words.collocation_hint: extraordinary ability; extraordinary circumstances; nothing extraordinary
words.mnemonics: extra（超出）+ ordinary（普通）= 超出普通的，就是非凡的。

words.translation: 极端, 末端；极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
words.example_en: The country experienced extreme weather this year.
words.example_zh: 这个国家今年经历了极端天气。

defs.text: The greatest or utmost point, degree or condition.
Each of the things at opposite ends of a range or scale.
defs.ex: extremes of temperature

defs.text: A drastic expedient.
defs.ex: Some people go to extremes for attention on social media.

words.exam_meaning: n. 极端, 末端；a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
words.collocation_hint: extreme weather; extreme poverty; in the extreme
words.mnemonics: ex（向外）+treme（极），向外到极点就是极端，联想“extremely”非常地。

words.translation: 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物；组织, 建筑物, 工厂
words.example_en: The fabric of society was torn by the war.
words.example_zh: 战争撕裂了社会结构。

defs.text: An edifice or building.
The act of constructing, construction, fabrication.
The structure of anything, the manner in which the parts of a thing are united; workmanship, texture, make.
defs.ex: cloth of a beautiful fabric

words.exam_meaning: n. 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物；组织, 建筑物, 工厂
words.collocation_hint: the fabric of society; cotton fabric; social fabric
words.mnemonics: fab（谐音“帆布”）+ric，帆布是织物，织物的结构就是构造。

words.example_en: That girl has a pretty face.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: face=脸，遇到困难要‘面对’，脸朝前不退缩。

words.example_en: The new tool facilitates communication.
words.example_zh: 新工具促进了沟通。
words.collocation_hint: facilitate the process; facilitate communication; be facilitated by
words.mnemonics: facil=容易，-ate使动，使事情变得容易，即促进便利。

words.example_en: The organization provides facilitation for international trade.
words.example_zh: 该组织为国际贸易提供便利。
words.mnemonics: facil-（容易）+ -ation（名词后缀），让事情变得容易，即促进、便利。

words.translation: 容易, 灵巧, 设备；设施; 设备; 装备
words.example_en: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
words.example_zh: 这家酒店有极好的体育设施。

defs.text: The fact of being easy, or easily done; absence of difficulty, simplicity.
Dexterity of speech or action; skill, talent.
defs.ex: The facility she shows in playing the violin is unrivalled.

defs.text: The physical means or contrivances to make something (especially a public service) possible; the required equipment, infrastructure, location etc.
defs.ex: Transport facilities in Bangkok are not sufficient to prevent frequent traffic collapses during rush hour.

words.exam_meaning: n. 容易, 灵巧, 设备；设施; 设备; 装备
words.collocation_hint: sports facilities; medical facility; public facilities
words.mnemonics: facil（容易）+ity（名词后缀）→使事情变容易的东西→设备；灵巧指做事容易。

words.translation: 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
words.example_en: The fact that prices are rising worries consumers.
words.example_zh: 物价上涨的事实令消费者担忧。

defs.text: Something actual as opposed to invented.
defs.ex: In this story, the Gettysburg Address is a fact, but the rest is fiction.

defs.text: Something which is real.
defs.ex: Gravity is a fact, not a theory.

defs.text: Something concrete used as a basis for further interpretation.
defs.ex: Let's look at the facts of the case before deciding.

words.exam_meaning: n. 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
words.collocation_hint: in fact; the fact that; as a matter of fact
words.mnemonics: fact=fact(做)，已经做出来的事就是事实，别再争了。

words.translation: 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人；因式
words.example_en: Cost is a key factor in the decision.
words.example_zh: 成本是决定的关键因素。

defs.text: A doer, maker; a person who does things for another person or organization.
defs.ex: The factor of the trading post bought the furs.

defs.text: An agent or representative.
A commission agent.

words.collocation_hint: factor in; key factor; contributing factor
words.mnemonics: fact(做)+or(人/物)=起作用的东西，即因素；数学中相乘的“做事者”是因数。

words.translation: 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系；能力, 院系
words.example_en: The faculty of the university includes many famous scholars.
words.example_zh: 这所大学的教师队伍中有许多著名学者。

defs.text: The academic staff at schools, colleges, universities or not-for-profit research institutes, as opposed to the students or support staff.
A division of a university.
defs.ex: She transferred from the Faculty of Science to the Faculty of Medicine.

defs.text: An ability, skill, or power, often plural.
defs.ex: He lived until he reached the age of 90 with most of his faculties intact.

words.exam_meaning: n. 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系；能力, 院系
words.collocation_hint: faculty of; faculty member; the faculty of law
words.mnemonics: fac(做)+ulty(名词后缀)，能做事的能力；大学里能做事的人就是教员。

words.translation: 褪色, 消失, 凋谢；使褪色；淡入, 淡出
words.example_en: The colors fade in the sunlight.
words.example_zh: 颜色在阳光下褪色。

defs.text: A golf shot that (for the right-handed player) curves intentionally to the right. See slice, hook, draw.
A haircut where the hair is short or shaved on the sides of the head and longer on top. See also high-top fade and low fade.
A fight.

words.exam_meaning: vi. 褪色, 消失, 凋谢；vt. 使褪色；n. 淡入, 淡出
words.collocation_hint: fade away; fade into; memories fade
words.mnemonics: fade谐音‘废的’，颜色废了=褪色，生命废了=凋谢，记忆废了=消失。

words.translation: 失败, 失败者, 不足, 缺乏, 破产；故障; 失效
words.example_en: The failure of the plan taught us a lesson.
words.example_zh: 计划的失败给我们上了一课。

defs.text: State or condition of not meeting a desirable or intended objective, opposite of success.
An object, person or endeavour in a state of failure or incapable of success.
Termination of the ability of an item to perform its required function; breakdown.

words.exam_meaning: n. 失败, 失败者, 不足, 缺乏, 破产；故障; 失效
words.collocation_hint: failure to do; failure of; heart failure
words.mnemonics: fail（失败）+ure（名词后缀），失败就是没达到目标，引申为不足和故障。

words.translation: 展览会, 市集, 美好的事物；公平的, 按规则进行的, 不好不坏的, 晴朗的, 美丽的；公平地, 正面地, 有教养地, 清楚地
words.example_en: The new tax system is fairer than the old one.
words.example_zh: 新税制比旧税制更公平。

defs.text: Something which is fair (in various senses of the adjective).
defs.ex: When will we learn to distinguish between the fair and the foul?

defs.text: A woman, a member of the ‘fair sex’; also as a collective singular, women.
Fairness, beauty.

words.collocation_hint: fair treatment; fair competition; to be fair
words.mnemonics: fair=公开的集市，公平买卖，联想“费尔”裁判很公正。

words.translation: 美观地, 公平地, 相当地, 清楚地
words.example_en: The task is fairly easy.
words.example_zh: 这项任务相当容易。

defs.text: (manner) In a fair manner; fair; not biased or skewed or favouring a certain party
defs.ex: A jury is expected to ensure that the accused is fairly judged.

defs.text: Favorably; auspiciously; commodiously.
defs.ex: a town fairly situated for foreign trade

defs.text: Honestly; properly.
defs.ex: Consumer laws aim to have consumers fairly treated.

words.exam_meaning: adv. 美观地, 公平地, 相当地, 清楚地
words.collocation_hint: fairly simple; fairly large; treat fairly
words.mnemonics: fair(公平)+ly=公平地；联想fair(公平)程度“相当”公平，即相当地。

words.translation: 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证；信任, 信仰, 信念
words.example_en: The public has faith in the justice system.
words.example_zh: 公众对司法系统有信心。

defs.text: A trust or confidence in the intentions or abilities of a person, object, or ideal from prior empirical evidence.
defs.ex: I have faith in the goodness of my fellow man.

defs.text: The process of forming or understanding abstractions, ideas, or beliefs, without empirical evidence, experience or observation.
defs.ex: I have faith in the healing power of crystals.

defs.text: A religious or spiritual belief system.
defs.ex: The Christian faith.

words.exam_meaning: n. 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证；信任, 信仰, 信念
words.collocation_hint: have faith in; lose faith in; keep faith with
words.mnemonics: faith=费心去信，对人或理念真心信任，不怀疑。

words.translation: 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的；不准确地, 欺诈地
words.example_en: The news turned out to be false.
words.example_zh: 这个消息被证明是假的。

defs.text: One of two options on a true-or-false test.
defs.ex: The student received a failing grade for circling every true and false on her quiz.

defs.text: Untrue, not factual, factually incorrect.
Based on factually incorrect premises.
defs.ex: false legislation, false punishment

words.exam_meaning: a. 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的；adv. 不准确地, 欺诈地
words.collocation_hint: false impression; false information; a false sense of
words.mnemonics: false=fa(发)+lse(乐死)，发假消息乐死人，记住“假”和“错”。

words.translation: 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的；熟友, 常客
words.example_en: The song sounds familiar to me.
words.example_zh: 这首歌我听着很熟悉。

defs.text: An attendant spirit, often in animal or demon form.
defs.ex: The witch’s familiar was a black cat.

defs.text: A member of one's family or household.
A member of a pope's or bishop's household.

words.exam_meaning: a. 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的；n. 熟友, 常客
words.collocation_hint: be familiar with; familiar to; sound familiar
words.mnemonics: family(家人)变familiar，家人是最熟悉亲密的人。

words.example_en: Our family lives in town.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: 家人聚在一起（fam）就是家庭，联想“family”中“fam”像“饭”，一家人吃饭。

words.translation: 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者；煽动, 刺激, 吹拂；飘动, 成扇形散开
words.example_en: He is a big fan of the team.
words.example_zh: 他是这支球队的铁杆球迷。

An electrical or mechanical device for moving air, used for cooling people, machinery, etc.
The action of fanning; agitation of the air.

words.exam_meaning: n. 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者；vt. 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂；vi. 飘动, 成扇形散开
words.collocation_hint: a fan of; football fan; fans and followers

defs.text: A special form of secured loan where the purpose of the loan must be specified to the lender, to purchase assets that must be fixed (not movable) property, such as a house or piece of farm land. The assets are registered as the legal property of the borrower but the lender can seize them and dispose of them if they are not satisfied with the manner in which the repayment of the loan is conducted by the borrower. Once the loan is fully repaid, the lender loses this right of seizure and the assets are then deemed to be unencumbered.
defs.ex: We're renting a property in the city centre because we can't afford to get a mortgage yet.

defs.text: State of being pledged.

defs.text: To borrow against a property, to obtain a loan for another purpose by giving away the right of seizure to the lender over a fixed property such as a house or piece of land; to pledge a property in order to get a loan.
