words.example_zh: 这项研究有多个原因。

defs.text: A whole number that can be divided by another number with no remainder.
defs.ex: 14, 21 and 70 are multiples of 7

defs.text: Price-earnings ratio.
One of a set of the same thing; a duplicate.

words.exam_meaning: n. 倍数, 并联；a. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的
words.collocation_hint: multiple factors; multiple choice; in multiple ways
words.mnemonics: multi-多 + ple折叠，多个折叠在一起，就是多样的、许多的。

words.translation: 谋杀；谋杀, 损毁, 破坏；犯杀人罪
words.example_en: The murder shocked the whole community.
words.example_zh: 这起谋杀震惊了整个社区。

defs.text: The crime of deliberately killing another person without justification.
defs.ex: The defendant was charged with murder.

defs.text: The act of deliberate killing of another person or other being without justification, especially with malice aforethought.
defs.ex: There have been ten unsolved murders this year alone.

defs.text: (in jurisdictions which use the felony murder rule) The commission of an act which abets the commission of a crime the commission of which causes the death of a human.

words.exam_meaning: n. 谋杀；vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏；vi. 犯杀人罪
words.collocation_hint: murder of; commit murder; attempted murder
words.mnemonics: mur（谐音“谋”）+der（谐音“得”）→谋得人命，即谋杀。

words.example_en: Regular exercise builds muscle.
words.example_zh: 经常锻炼能增强肌肉。

defs.text: A contractile form of tissue which animals use to effect movement.
defs.ex: Muscle consists largely of actin and myosin filaments.

defs.text: An organ composed of muscle tissue.
(usually in the plural) A well-developed physique, in which the muscles are enlarged from exercise.

words.collocation_hint: muscle strength; muscle pain; build muscle
words.mnemonics: mus（老鼠）+cle（小），老鼠虽小但肌肉发达，力量大。

words.example_en: The museum houses a collection of ancient art.
words.example_zh: 博物馆收藏有古代艺术品。

defs.text: A building or institution dedicated to the acquisition, conservation, study, exhibition, and educational interpretation of objects having scientific, historical, cultural or artistic value.

words.collocation_hint: museum of; art museum; visit a museum
words.mnemonics: 缪斯（muse）女神掌管艺术，艺术藏品放在博物馆（um）里。

words.translation: 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧；音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的
words.example_en: She has great musical talent.
words.example_zh: 她很有音乐天赋。
words.exam_meaning: n. 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧；a. 音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的
words.collocation_hint: musical instrument; musical talent; musical performance
words.mnemonics: music（音乐）+al（形容词后缀），和音乐有关的，引申为音乐剧。

words.translation: 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家
words.example_en: The musician performed in the city hall.
words.example_zh: 音乐家在市政厅演出。

defs.text: A composer, conductor, or performer of music; specifically, a person who sings and/or plays a musical instrument as a hobby, an occupation, or a profession.

words.exam_meaning: n. 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家
words.collocation_hint: musician of; a famous musician; jazz musician
words.mnemonics: music（音乐）+ian（人），玩音乐的人就是音乐家。

words.example_en: The two countries share mutual interests.
words.example_zh: 两国拥有共同利益。
words.collocation_hint: mutual benefit; mutual respect; mutual understanding
words.mnemonics: mut（互相）+ual（形容词后缀），互相的就是相互的、共同的。

words.translation: 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
words.example_en: The mystery of the missing painting remains unsolved.
words.example_zh: 名画失踪之谜仍未解开。

defs.text: Something secret or unexplainable; an unknown.
defs.ex: The truth behind the events remains a mystery.

defs.text: Someone or something with an obscure or puzzling nature.
defs.ex: That man is a mystery.

defs.text: A secret or mystical meaning.

words.exam_meaning: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
words.collocation_hint: mystery of; remain a mystery; solve the mystery
words.mnemonics: “谜死你”——神秘的事物让你猜不透，像谜一样迷住你。

words.translation: 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人
words.example_en: The idea that money brings happiness is a myth.
words.example_zh: 金钱带来幸福的想法是一个迷思。

defs.text: A traditional story which embodies a belief regarding some fact or phenomenon of experience, and in which often the forces of nature and of the soul are personified; a sacred narrative regarding a god, a hero, the origin of the world or of a people, etc.
Such stories as a genre.
defs.ex: Myth was the product of man's emotion and imagination, acted upon by his surroundings. (E. Clodd, Myths & Dreams (1885), 7, cited after OED)

defs.text: A commonly-held but false belief, a common misconception; a fictitious or imaginary person or thing; a popular conception about a real person or event which exaggerates or idealizes reality.
defs.ex: Scientists debunk the myth that gum stays in the human stomach for seven years.

words.exam_meaning: n. 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人
words.collocation_hint: myth of; a common myth; dispel the myth
words.mnemonics: my+th=我的传说，神话就是虚构的，别当真。

words.translation: 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的；裸露的
words.example_en: The naked truth is hard to accept.
words.example_zh: 赤裸裸的事实很难接受。

defs.text: Bare, not covered by clothing.
defs.ex: She was as naked as the day she was born.

defs.text: Lacking some clothing; clothed only in underwear.
Glib, without decoration, put bluntly.
defs.ex: The naked facts lay there on the table, enclosed within the files.

words.exam_meaning: a. 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的；裸露的
words.collocation_hint: naked eye; the naked truth; naked aggression
words.mnemonics: na（拿）+ked（谐音“开的”）→ 衣服被拿开，身体裸露，毫无保护。

words.example_en: They named the baby after his grandfather.
words.example_zh: 他们以祖父的名字给婴儿命名。
words.collocation_hint: in the name of; name after; make a name for oneself
words.mnemonics: name=名字，记住“点名”就是叫名字，命名就是起名字。

words.example_en: Nanotechnology is used in medicine and materials science.
words.example_zh: 纳米技术应用于医学和材料科学。
words.mnemonics: nano（纳米）+technology（技术），纳米级别的技术就是纳米技术。

words.translation: 叙述, 故事；叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的
words.example_en: The narrative of the novel is gripping.
words.example_zh: 小说的叙事扣人心弦。

defs.text: The systematic recitation of an event or series of events.
That which is narrated.
A representation of an event or story.

words.exam_meaning: n. 叙述, 故事；a. 叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的
words.collocation_hint: narrative of; a compelling narrative; narrative structure
words.mnemonics: narr（说）+ative→说出来的内容→叙述、故事

words.translation: 狭窄部分, 隘路；狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的；变窄
words.example_en: The gap between the two groups is narrowing.
words.example_zh: 两个群体之间的差距正在缩小。

defs.text: (chiefly in the plural) A narrow passage, especially a contracted part of a stream, lake, or sea; a strait connecting two bodies of water.
defs.ex: the narrows of New York harbor

defs.text: Having a small width; not wide; having opposite edges or sides that are close, especially by comparison to length or depth.
defs.ex: a narrow hallway

defs.text: Of little extent; very limited; circumscribed.

words.collocation_hint: narrow the gap; a narrow majority; narrow escape
words.mnemonics: narrow=窄，想象一条窄路，勉强挤过去，路变窄了。

words.translation: 国家, 民族；民族, 国家
words.example_en: The whole nation mourned the loss.
words.example_zh: 全国都在哀悼这一损失。

defs.text: A historically constituted, stable community of people, formed on the basis of a common language, territory, economic life, ethnicity and/or psychological make-up manifested in a common culture.
defs.ex: The Kurdish people constitute a nation in the Middle East

defs.text: A sovereign state.
defs.ex: Though legally single nations, many states comprise several distinct cultural or ethnic groups.

defs.text: An association of students based on its members' birthplace or ethnicity.
defs.ex: Once widespread across Europe in medieval times, nations are now largely restricted to the ancient universities of Sweden and Finland.

words.exam_meaning: n. 国家, 民族；民族, 国家
words.collocation_hint: nation of; across the nation; a nation of
words.mnemonics: nat-出生，出生在同一片土地的人组成国家或民族。

words.translation: 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的；全国性的, 国家的, 国民的
words.example_en: The event attracted national attention.
words.example_zh: 这一事件引起全国关注。

defs.text: A subject of a nation.
defs.ex: The diplomats were advised not to interact with any foreign nationals except on official duty.

defs.text: (usually in the plural) A tournament in which participants from all over the nation compete.
defs.ex: After winning the regional tournament, the team advanced to the nationals.

defs.text: Of or having to do with a nation.

words.exam_meaning: a. 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的；全国性的, 国家的, 国民的
words.collocation_hint: national identity; national security; national economy
words.mnemonics: nation（国家）+al（形容词后缀）=国家的；联想“国家民族全国性”三合一。

words.example_en: The government nationalized the banks.
words.example_zh: 政府将银行国有化。
words.collocation_hint: nationalize the industry; be nationalized; nationalized banks
words.mnemonics: nation（国家）+alize（使动后缀）→使归国家所有，即国有化。

words.translation: 本地人, 土产, 当地人；本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
words.example_en: She is a native speaker of English.
words.example_zh: 她的母语是英语。

defs.text: An aboriginal inhabitant of a region colonized by English-speaking people; in particular:
Aboriginal inhabitant of a region colonized by English-speaking people; in particular:
A person who is native to a place; a person who was born in a place.

words.exam_meaning: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人；a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
words.collocation_hint: native language; native speaker; native to
words.mnemonics: na(那)+tive(踢我)→那地方踢我长大的，就是本国和本地人。

words.translation: 白痴；自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
words.example_en: It is natural for children to be curious.
words.example_zh: 孩子好奇是很自然的。

defs.text: A native inhabitant of a place, country etc.
A note that is not or is no longer to be modified by an accidental.
The symbol ♮ used to indicate such a natural note.

words.exam_meaning: n. 白痴；a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
words.collocation_hint: natural resources; natural disaster; it is natural that
words.mnemonics: nat=出生，-ural形容词后缀，天生如此就是自然、天然、正常。

words.translation: 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质；自然, 大自然; 本性, 性能
words.example_en: The nature of the problem is economic, not political.
words.example_zh: 问题的本质是经济问题,不是政治问题。

defs.text: The natural world; that which consists of all things unaffected by or predating human technology, production, and design. (Compare ecosystem.)
defs.ex: Nature never lies (i.e. tells untruths).

defs.text: The innate characteristics of a thing. What something will tend by its own constitution, to be or do. Distinct from what might be expected or intended.
The summary of everything that has to do with biological, chemical and physical states and events in the physical universe.

words.collocation_hint: nature of; by nature; human nature
words.mnemonics: na（那）+ture（真实），那真实的样子就是自然和本性。

words.example_en: The ship nears the land.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: near 谐音“尼儿”，尼儿就在你附近，距离很近。

words.translation: 附近的, 近旁的；在附近, 近旁地；在...附近
words.example_en: The school is nearby the station.
words.example_zh: 学校在车站附近。

defs.text: Adjacent, near, close by
defs.ex: He stopped at a nearby store for some groceries.

defs.text: Next to, close to
defs.ex: I'm glad my friends live nearby where I can visit them.

words.exam_meaning: a. 附近的, 近旁的；adv. 在附近, 近旁地；prep. 在...附近
words.collocation_hint: nearby town; nearby residents; somewhere nearby
words.mnemonics: near（近）+ by（旁边）= 就在近旁，联想“近在咫尺”。

words.example_en: He left a nearly full beer on the bar.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: near（近）+ly，离目标很近，就是“几乎”达到了。

words.example_en: Although I wished to think that all was false, it was yet necessary that I, who thus thought, must in some sense exist.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: necessary 拆成 ne-cess-ary，cess 表示“走”，走不掉的就是“必需的”，名词就是“必需品”。

words.translation: 脖子, 衣领, 颈；拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩；割颈
words.example_en: The company is neck and neck with its rival.
words.example_zh: 公司与竞争对手并驾齐驱。

defs.text: The part of the body connecting the head and the trunk found in humans and some animals.
defs.ex: Giraffes have long necks.

defs.text: The corresponding part in some other anatomical contexts.
The part of a shirt, dress etc., which fits a person's neck.

words.exam_meaning: n. 脖子, 衣领, 颈；vi. 拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩；vt. 割颈
words.collocation_hint: neck and neck; neck of; up to one's neck in
words.mnemonics: 脖子（neck）上戴着项链（necklace），衣领（neck）围着脖子，记住脖子和衣领即可。

words.translation: 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片；否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的；负数, 负值
words.example_en: The new policy had a negative effect on small firms.
words.example_zh: 新政策对小企业产生了负面影响。

defs.text: Refusal or withholding of assents; prohibition, veto
A right of veto.
An image in which dark areas represent light ones, and the converse.

words.exam_meaning: n. 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片；a. 否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的；n. 负数, 负值
words.collocation_hint: negative effect; negative attitude; negative impact
words.mnemonics: neg（否定）+ative（形容词后缀），否定态度就是消极的。

words.example_en: We found errors, but their effects were negligible.
words.mnemonics: neg(不)+lig(选择)+ible(能)，不值得选，就是微不足道的。

words.example_en: The two sides are negotiating a trade deal.
words.example_zh: 双方正在谈判一项贸易协议。
words.collocation_hint: negotiate with; negotiate a deal; be negotiated
words.mnemonics: neg（否定）+oti（谐音“哦提”）+ate，谈判时互相否定对方提议，哦，提出来再协商。

words.translation: 邻居；邻接；毗邻而居, 友好
words.example_en: The two countries are friendly neighbors.
words.example_zh: 这两个国家是友好邻邦。

defs.text: A person living on adjacent or nearby land; a person situated adjacently or nearby; anything (of the same type of thing as the subject) in an adjacent or nearby position.
defs.ex: My neighbour has two noisy cats.

defs.text: One who is near in sympathy or confidence.
A fellow human being.

words.exam_meaning: n. 邻居；vt. 邻接；vi. 毗邻而居, 友好
words.collocation_hint: neighbor of; next-door neighbor; neighbors and friends
words.mnemonics: neigh（马叫）+bor（伯），马叫的隔壁大伯就是邻居。

words.example_en: The neighborhood has changed a lot.
words.example_zh: 这个社区变化很大。

defs.text: The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.
defs.ex: Our neighborhood was our only reason to exchange hollow greetings.

defs.text: Close proximity, nearby area; particularly, close proximity to one's home.
defs.ex: He lives in my neighborhood.

defs.text: The inhabitants of a residential area.
defs.ex: The fire alarmed the neighborhood.

words.collocation_hint: in the neighborhood of; neighborhood school; local neighborhood
words.mnemonics: neigh（邻居）+borhood（区域），邻居住的区域就是附近。

words.translation: 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经；鼓起勇气
words.example_en: She had the nerve to question the boss.
words.example_zh: 她竟有胆量质疑老板。
words.exam_meaning: n. 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经；vt. 鼓起勇气
words.collocation_hint: nerve to do; lose one's nerve; nerves of steel
words.mnemonics: nerve谐音‘乐福’，有勇气的人才能乐享福气。

words.translation: 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的；神经的; 神经质的, 神经过敏的
words.example_en: She felt nervous before the interview.
words.example_zh: 面试前她感到紧张。

defs.text: Of sinews and tendons.
Of nerves.

words.exam_meaning: a. 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的；神经的; 神经质的, 神经过敏的
words.collocation_hint: nervous about; feel nervous; nervous system
words.mnemonics: nerve（神经）+ous（形容词后缀），神经绷紧了，自然就紧张不安。

words.translation: 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价；净的, 最终的；用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到
words.example_en: The net profit of the company doubled.
words.example_zh: 公司的净利润翻了一番。
words.exam_meaning: n. 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价；a. 净的, 最终的；vt. 用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到
words.collocation_hint: net profit; net income; on the net
words.mnemonics: net 像一张网，网住“净”利润，最终到手才是真。

words.translation: 网络, 广播网, 网状物；网络
words.example_en: The railway network covers the whole country.
words.example_zh: 铁路网覆盖全国。

defs.text: A fabric or structure of fibrous elements attached to each other at regular intervals.
Any interconnected group or system
defs.ex: A network of roads crisscrossed the country.

defs.text: A directory of people maintained for their advancement
defs.ex: To get a job in today's economy, it is important to have a strong network.

words.exam_meaning: n. 网络, 广播网, 网状物；网络
words.collocation_hint: network of; social network; transport network
words.mnemonics: net（网）+ work（工作）→ 网在工作，即网络连接起来工作。

words.example_en: The system uses neural networks.
words.example_zh: 该系统使用神经网络。
words.collocation_hint: neural network; neural activity; neural pathways
words.mnemonics: neur-（神经）+ -al（形容词后缀），联想“神经元”就是神经细胞。

words.translation: 然而, 虽然如此；然而
words.example_en: The plan is risky; nevertheless, we should try.
words.example_zh: 这个计划有风险,但我们仍应尝试。

defs.text: In spite of what preceded; yet.

words.exam_meaning: adv. 然而, 虽然如此；conj. 然而
words.collocation_hint: nevertheless, it; but nevertheless; however, nevertheless
words.mnemonics: never(从不)+the+less(更少)，从不减少，转折语气，意为“然而”。

words.example_en: How do you sleep at night when you attack your kids like that!?
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: night=ni(你)+ght(ght谐音'给他')，夜晚你给他一个拥抱。

words.translation: 点头, 打盹, 晃动；点头, 打盹；点头表示, 点(头)
words.example_en: She nodded in agreement.
words.example_zh: 她点头表示同意。

defs.text: An instance of inclining the head up and down, as to indicate agreement, or as a cursory greeting.
A reference or allusion to something.
A nomination.

words.exam_meaning: n. 点头, 打盹, 晃动；vi. 点头, 打盹；vt. 点头表示, 点(头)
words.collocation_hint: nod at; nod in agreement; give a nod

words.translation: 然而, 尽管, 不过；不过, 仍然, 尽管如此, 然而

words.example_zh: 计划有风险,但仍然值得一试。

defs.text: Nevertheless.

words.exam_meaning: conj. 然而, 尽管, 不过；adv. 不过, 仍然, 尽管如此, 然而
words.collocation_hint: nonetheless, the; but nonetheless; nonetheless, it
words.mnemonics: none(没有)+the+less(更少)，即使更少也没有，即‘尽管如此’仍然如此。

words.translation: 基准, 模范, 标准, 准则, 平均数；定额
words.example_en: Working from home has become the norm.
words.example_zh: 居家办公已成为常态。

defs.text: That which is normal or typical.
defs.ex: Unemployment is the norm in this part of the country.

words.collocation_hint: commit suicide; suicide rate; attempted suicide
words.mnemonics: sui(自己)+cide(杀)，自己杀自己，就是自杀。

words.translation: 套装, 诉讼, 请求, 起诉, 套, 组；适合, 使适应；合适, 相称
words.example_en: The policy suits the needs of the times.
words.example_zh: 这项政策适合时代需要。

defs.text: A set of clothes to be worn together, now especially a man's matching jacket and trousers (also business suit or lounge suit), or a similar outfit for a woman.
defs.ex: Nick hired a navy-blue suit for the wedding.

defs.text: (by extension) A single garment that covers the whole body: space suit, boiler suit, protective suit.
(metonym) A person who wears matching jacket and trousers, especially a boss or a supervisor.
defs.ex: Be sure to keep your nose to the grindstone today; the suits are making a "surprise" visit to this department.

words.collocation_hint: suit the needs; be suited to; a suit against
words.mnemonics: suit=适合的套装，穿上它去打官司。

words.collocation_hint: sum of; in sum; a large sum of money

words.translation: 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议；政府首脑的, 最高级的
words.example_en: Leaders met at the summit to discuss trade.
words.example_zh: 各国领导人在峰会上讨论贸易问题。

defs.text: A peak; the topmost point or surface, as of a mountain.
defs.ex: In summer, it is possible to hike to the summit of Mount Shasta.

defs.ex: They met for an international summit on environmental issues.

defs.text: (hiking) To reach the summit of a mountain.

words.exam_meaning: n. 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议；a. 政府首脑的, 最高级的
words.collocation_hint: summit of; at the summit; a summit meeting
words.mnemonics: sum（最高）+mit（送）→把最高层送到一起开会，就是峰会顶点。

words.translation: 跑龙套角色, 冗员, 特级品, 特大号, 管理人；上等的, 特大的, 超级的, 极好的, 十分的, 过分的；非常
words.example_en: The new system is super efficient.
words.example_zh: 新系统效率超高。

defs.text: Of excellent quality, superfine.

words.exam_meaning: n. 跑龙套角色, 冗员, 特级品, 特大号, 管理人；a. 上等的, 特大的, 超级的, 极好的, 十分的, 过分的；adv. 非常
words.collocation_hint: super bowl; super powers; super efficient
words.mnemonics: super-表示“在上、超越”，联想“超级”就是超越一般，极好就是超越普通。

words.translation: 长者, 占优势的人, 上级；上级的, 出众的, 高傲的

defs.text: A person of higher rank or quality.
The senior person in a monastic community.
The head of certain churches and colleges.

words.exam_meaning: n. 长者, 占优势的人, 上级；a. 上级的, 出众的, 高傲的
words.collocation_hint: superior to; be superior in; superior quality
words.mnemonics: super（超）+ior（比较级后缀）=超越一般的人，即上级、出众的。

words.example_en: Vitamin supplements can help people with poor diets.
words.example_zh: 营养补充剂可以帮助饮食不良的人。
words.exam_meaning: v. 补充 n. 补充物

defs.text: (in the plural) provisions.

words.collocation_hint: supply of; supply and demand; in short supply
words.mnemonics: sup（下面）+ply（填满），从下面填满，就是供给、供应。

words.translation: 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物；支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实；后援; 支持

words.example_zh: 这一理论有证据支持。

defs.ex: Don't move that beam! It's a support for the whole platform.

defs.text: Financial or other help.

defs.text: Answers to questions and resolution of problems regarding something sold.
defs.ex: Sure they sell the product, but do they provide support?

words.collocation_hint: support for; in support of; support the idea
words.mnemonics: sup-向上 + port-携带，向上托着带，就是支撑、支持；供养也是托起一家人的生活。

words.translation: 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定；料想

words.example_zh: 我想这个计划会奏效。

defs.text: To theorize or hypothesize.
defs.ex: I suppose we all agree that this is the best solution.

defs.text: To imagine; to believe; to receive as true.

words.collocation_hint: suppose that; be supposed to; I suppose
words.mnemonics: sup（下面）+pose（放）=放在心里作为前提，即“假设、料想”。

words.example_zh: 他压抑住了愤怒。

words.example_zh: 该国曾在该地区享有海军优势。

words.translation: 至高, 霸权；至高的, 终极的, 极端的, 最大的

words.example_zh: 最高法院做出了最终裁决。

defs.text: The highest point.

A breast of chicken or duck with the wing bone attached.

words.exam_meaning: n. 至高, 霸权；a. 至高的, 终极的, 极端的, 最大的
words.collocation_hint: supreme court; supreme authority; of supreme importance
words.mnemonics: supreme = super(超级) + eme，超级的就是最高、最大的。

words.mnemonics: sur-（上）+ face（脸）→ 脸露出来 → 表面；浮出水面。

words.translation: 外科医生, 军医, 船医；外科医师

words.example_zh: 外科医生成功完成了手术。

defs.text: One who performs surgery; a doctor who performs operations on people or animals.

defs.text: A surgeonfish.

words.exam_meaning: n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医；外科医师
words.collocation_hint: surgeon of; a heart surgeon; brain surgeon
words.mnemonics: sur（在上）+geon（谐音‘诊’）→ 在手术台上诊治的人，即外科医生。

words.translation: 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术

words.example_zh: 病人需要做膝盖手术。

defs.text: A procedure involving major incisions to remove, repair, or replace a part of a body.

words.exam_meaning: n. 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术
words.collocation_hint: surgery of; undergo surgery; heart surgery
words.mnemonics: sur（在外）+gery（工作），在体外做的工作，即外科手术。

words.example_en: The farm sold its surplus grain to the government.
words.example_zh: 农场把剩余的粮食卖给了政府。
words.mnemonics: sur（超过）+plus（加）→加多了，剩下就是剩余。

words.translation: 包围, 环绕, 围绕；围绕物

words.example_zh: 小镇四面环山。

To encircle something or simultaneously extend in all directions.
To enclose or confine something on all sides so as to prevent escape.

words.exam_meaning: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕；n. 围绕物
words.collocation_hint: be surrounded by; surround with; surround the issue
words.mnemonics: sur（在上）+ round（圆）→ 在四周画个圆，就是包围环绕。

words.example_en: The government expanded surveillance of the internet.
words.example_zh: 政府扩大了对互联网的监控。
words.collocation_hint: surveillance of; under surveillance; mass surveillance
words.mnemonics: sur(上)+veil(面纱)+lance(长矛)=上面用长矛挑开面纱，暗中监视你。

words.example_zh: 调查覆盖五千户家庭。
words.collocation_hint: survey of; a survey on; conduct a survey
words.mnemonics: sur(在上)+vey(看)=从上往下看，即调查、审视全局。

words.translation: 生存, 残存, 幸存者；赖以生存的

words.example_zh: 该物种的生存取决于栖息地保护。

defs.text: The fact or act of surviving; continued existence or life.
defs.ex: His survival in the open ocean was a miracle; he had fully expected to die.

defs.text: (as a modifier) Of, relating to or aiding survival.
defs.ex: His survival kit had all the things he needed in the wilderness.

words.exam_meaning: n. 生存, 残存, 幸存者；a. 赖以生存的
words.collocation_hint: survival of; the survival of the fittest; survival skills
words.mnemonics: sur（在上）+viv（活）+al（名词后缀）→在灾难之上活下来，就是幸存。

words.translation: 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于；活下来, 幸存
words.example_en: The company survived the crisis.
words.example_zh: 公司挺过了危机。

defs.text: Of a person, to continue to live; to remain alive.
Of an object or concept, to continue to exist.
To live longer than; to outlive.

words.collocation_hint: survive on; survive the crisis; manage to survive
words.mnemonics: sur(上)+viv(活)+e，活下来就是幸存，活得比人长就是“比...活得长”。

words.translation: 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯；令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的；怀疑, 猜想

words.example_zh: 警方怀疑他盗窃。
words.collocation_hint: suspect that; suspect sb of; a suspect in

words.example_zh: 经济无法维持这样的增长。
words.collocation_hint: sustain growth; sustain the development; be sustained by
words.mnemonics: sus-（下）+tain（拿住），从下面拿住，即支撑、维持。

words.example_en: Sustainability has become a central concern of modern business.
words.example_zh: 可持续性已成为现代企业的核心关切。
words.mnemonics: sustain（维持）+ ability（能力）= 维持下去的能力，即可持续性。

words.example_en: The city promotes sustainable forms of transport.
words.example_zh: 该市推广可持续的交通方式。
words.mnemonics: sus-（在下面）+tain（保持）+able（可…的），在下面一直保持住，就是可持续的。

words.example_zh: 公司承担了损失。
words.collocation_hint: swallow up; swallow the loss; a swallow of

words.example_zh: 他发誓说出真相。

words.mnemonics: swell（肿胀）+ing，s像蛇，well井，蛇在井里肿胀起来。

words.collocation_hint: swing in; swing between; a swing of

words.translation: 开关, 电闸, 转换, 软枝, 鞭子, 道岔；转变, 切换, 摆动, 转换, 使转轨；转换, 变换, 摆动

words.example_zh: 公司换用了新系统。

words.collocation_hint: switch to; switch on; a switch in
words.mnemonics: switch像电闸，一拨就切换，开关转换记心间。

words.collocation_hint: symbol of; a symbol for; the symbol of peace
words.mnemonics: sym（共同）+bol（抛），共同抛出的标志物，即符号和象征。

words.example_zh: 教育体系需要改革。

words.collocation_hint: system of; the education system; social system
words.mnemonics: sys（一起）+tem（词根‘放置’）→放在一起成系统；谐音‘系统’直接记。

words.example_zh: 双方坐在谈判桌前。

words.example_zh: 团队采用了新战术。

words.exam_meaning: n. 一项战术, 一条策略；a. 战术的, 顺序的, 排列的

words.translation: 条约, 谈判；协议, 协定, 协商
words.example_en: The two countries signed a peace treaty.
words.example_zh: 两国签署了和平条约。
words.exam_meaning: n. 条约, 谈判；协议, 协定, 协商
words.collocation_hint: treaty of; sign a treaty; a peace treaty
words.mnemonics: treat（处理）+y→处理国际关系靠条约，记住“谈判处理成协议”。

words.translation: 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
words.example_en: The project was a tremendous success.
words.example_zh: 这个项目取得了巨大成功。

defs.text: Awe-inspiring; terrific.
Notable for its size, power, or excellence.
defs.ex: Van Beethoven's ninth symphony is a tremendous piece of music.

defs.text: Extremely large (in amount, extent, degree, etc.) or great
defs.ex: There was a tremendous outpouring of support.

words.collocation_hint: tremendous success; tremendous pressure; a tremendous amount of
words.mnemonics: trem(颤抖)+endous→让人颤抖的→巨大的，非常厉害的。

words.example_en: There is a growing trend toward online shopping.
words.example_zh: 网上购物呈增长趋势。
words.collocation_hint: trend toward; the trend of; set a trend
words.mnemonics: trend像tend（倾向），加r就像一股向前的流，合起来就是趋势。

words.translation: 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验；审讯的, 试验性的
words.example_en: The new drug is in clinical trials.
words.example_zh: 新药正在进行临床试验。

defs.text: An opportunity to test something out; a test.
defs.ex: They will perform the trials for the new equipment next week.

defs.text: Appearance at judicial court in order to be examined.
A difficult or annoying experience.
defs.ex: That boy was a trial to his parents.

words.collocation_hint: trial of; on trial; clinical trials
words.mnemonics: tri（三）+al（形容词后缀）→三次试验后接受审判，真是考验。

words.translation: 宗族, 部落, 一群人；族(生物分类)
words.example_en: The tribe lives deep in the forest.
words.example_zh: 这个部落生活在森林深处。

defs.text: A socially, ethnically, or politically cohesive group of people.
A society larger than a band but smaller than a state.
A group of apes who live and work together.

words.exam_meaning: n. 宗族, 部落, 一群人；族(生物分类)
words.collocation_hint: tribe of; a tribe of; tribal people
words.mnemonics: tri(三)+be(是)→三个人就是一个小部落，记住“部落”即可。

words.translation: 诡计, 欺诈, 谋略, 恶作剧, 习惯, 决窍；愚弄, 欺骗, 装饰；哄骗, 戏弄
words.example_en: The market is full of tricks.
words.example_zh: 市场上充满把戏。

defs.text: Something designed to fool or swindle.
defs.ex: It was just a trick to say that the house was underpriced.

defs.text: A single element of a magician's (or any variety entertainer's) act; a magic trick.
defs.ex: And for my next trick, I will pull a wombat out of a duffel bag.

defs.text: An entertaining difficult physical action.
defs.ex: That's a nice skateboard, but can you do any tricks on it?

words.collocation_hint: trick of; play a trick; a trick to
words.mnemonics: tri(三)+ck(刺客)，三个刺客用诡计骗你，但识破后就是诀窍。

words.example_en: The event triggered a debate.
words.example_zh: 这一事件引发了一场辩论。
words.collocation_hint: trigger a crisis; be triggered by; trigger a debate
words.mnemonics: tri(三)+gger(哥)，三哥一按开关，就触发事件。

words.example_en: The trip to the museum was inspiring.
words.example_zh: 博物馆之行令人鼓舞。
words.collocation_hint: trip to; on a trip; a trip abroad
words.mnemonics: tri-三，p像腿，三条腿走路容易绊倒，出门旅行要小心。

words.example_en: The victory was a triumph for the team.
words.example_zh: 这场胜利是球队的凯旋。
words.collocation_hint: triumph over; a triumph of; in triumph
words.mnemonics: tri（三）+umph（谐音“昂首”）→三次夺冠后昂首挺胸，胜利！

words.translation: 军队, 一群, 一队；群集, 结队, 成群而行
words.example_en: The troops were sent to the border.
words.example_zh: 军队被派往边境。

defs.text: (collective) A collection of people; a number; a multitude (in general).
A small unit of cavalry or armour commanded by a captain, corresponding to a platoon or company of infantry.
A detachment of soldiers or police, especially horse artillery, armour, or state troopers.

words.collocation_hint: troops of; a troop of; send troops
words.mnemonics: troop像troup(e)，一群人结队去troop(部队)集合，成群而行。

words.example_en: The plan ran into trouble.
words.example_zh: 计划遇到了麻烦。
words.collocation_hint: trouble with; in trouble; cause trouble
words.mnemonics: trouble=tr(踢)+ouble(ouble像ouble)，踢到麻烦事，心里烦恼。

words.translation: 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话；对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输；驾驶卡车, 以物易物
words.example_en: The truck delivers goods to the store.
words.example_zh: 卡车给商店送货。

defs.text: A small wheel or roller, specifically the wheel of a gun carriage.
The ball on top of a flagpole.

On a wooden mast, a circular disc (or sometimes a rectangle) of wood near or at the top of the mast, usually with holes or sheaves to reeve signal halyards; also a temporary or emergency place for a lookout. "Main" refers to the mainmast, whereas a truck on another mast may be called (on the mizzenmast, for example) "mizzen-truck".

words.exam_meaning: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话；vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输；vi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
words.collocation_hint: truck of; by truck; truck driver
words.mnemonics: 卡车（truck）运货，谐音“踹卡车”，一脚踹开货车门，记住它是货车。

words.example_en: The story is true.
words.example_zh: 这个故事是真的。
words.collocation_hint: true to; come true; it is true that
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: true 像“出”，真实的东西才敢拿出来给人看，不掺假。

words.translation: 信任, 信赖, 相信, 受托, 职责, 信心, 托拉斯；信托的, 托拉斯的；信赖, 信任, 相信, 盼望, 赊卖给
words.example_en: The public trusts the news media less than before.
words.example_zh: 公众对新闻媒体的信任不如从前。

defs.text: Confidence in or reliance on some person or quality.
defs.ex: He needs to regain her trust if he is ever going to win her back.

defs.text: Dependence upon something in the future; hope.
Confidence in the future payment for goods or services supplied; credit.
defs.ex: I was out of cash, but the landlady let me have it on trust.

words.collocation_hint: trust in; build trust; a relationship of trust
words.mnemonics: trust=tr+ust，想象‘trust’是‘true’（真实）的兄弟，对真实的东西才信任。

words.translation: 事实, 实情；真实, 真相, 事实
words.example_en: The truth of the matter is complex.
words.example_zh: 事情的真相很复杂。

defs.text: True facts, genuine depiction or statements of reality.
defs.ex: The truth is that our leaders knew a lot more than they were letting on.

defs.text: Conformity to fact or reality; correctness, accuracy.
defs.ex: There was some truth in his statement that he had no other choice.

defs.text: The state or quality of being true to someone or something.
defs.ex: Truth to one's own feelings is all-important in life.

words.exam_meaning: n. 事实, 实情；真实, 真相, 事实
words.collocation_hint: truth of; tell the truth; the truth about
words.mnemonics: tru=真，th是名词后缀，记住“真”就是事实和真相。

words.example_en: The government tried a new approach.
words.example_zh: 政府尝试了一种新方法。
words.collocation_hint: try to do; try doing; try out
words.mnemonics: try=tr+y，try一下（y）试试，不行就上法庭（审判）？谐音“踹”，踹一脚试试看。

words.example_en: I tried to rollerblade, but I couldn’t.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: try（尝试）+ing→反复尝试的过程让人厌烦，费劲。

words.translation: 管, 软管, 隧道；把...装管, 使通过管子；管子
words.example_en: The news travels through the tube of the internet.
words.example_zh: 消息通过互联网管道传播。

defs.text: Anything that is hollow and cylindrical in shape.
An approximately cylindrical container, usually with a crimped end and a screw top, used to contain and dispense semiliquid substances.
defs.ex: A tube of toothpaste.

defs.text: (often capitalized as Tube) The London Underground railway system, originally referred to the lower level lines that ran in tubular tunnels as opposed to the higher ones which ran in rectangular section tunnels. (Often the tube.)
defs.ex: I took the tube to Waterloo and walked the rest of the way.

words.exam_meaning: n. 管, 软管, 隧道；vt. 把...装管, 使通过管子；管子
words.collocation_hint: tube of; a tube of; test tube
words.mnemonics: tu像管道形状，be是存在，管道存在的地方就是隧道。

words.example_en: The policy is tuned to the needs of the market.
words.example_zh: 政策与市场需求相适应。
words.collocation_hint: tune to; in tune with; tune in
words.mnemonics: 调(tiao)整音调(tiao)才能唱出好曲调，tune谐音“调”，一调就顺。

words.translation: 隧道, 地下道；挖隧道；掘隧道于
words.example_en: The tunnel connects the two islands.
words.example_zh: 隧道连接两座岛屿。

defs.text: An underground or underwater passage.
A passage through or under some obstacle.
A hole in the ground made by an animal, a burrow.

words.exam_meaning: n. 隧道, 地下道；vi. 挖隧道；vt. 掘隧道于
words.collocation_hint: tunnel of; through a tunnel; the Channel Tunnel
words.mnemonics: tun像‘通’，nel像‘洞’，通到洞里的就是隧道。

words.translation: 火鸡, 无用的家伙, 土耳其
words.example_en: The family eats turkey at Thanksgiving.
words.example_zh: 这家人感恩节吃火鸡。

defs.text: The guinea fowl (family Numididae).
A bird in the genus Meleagris with a fan-shaped tail and wattled neck, especially the wild turkey (Meleagris gallopavo, now domesticated).
The flesh or meat of this bird eaten as food.
defs.ex: All week after Thanksgiving, I had turkey sandwiches for lunch.

words.exam_meaning: n. 火鸡, 无用的家伙, 土耳其
words.collocation_hint: turkey of; roast turkey; talk turkey
words.mnemonics: 火鸡在土耳其被烤熟，turkey既是火鸡也是土耳其。

words.example_en: The company turned a profit last year.
words.example_zh: 公司去年扭亏为盈。
words.collocation_hint: turn out; turn into; in turn
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: turn像“特恩”，特恩一转，局面就转变，轮到你上场。

words.example_en: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: turn是转，加-ing表示动作或地点，转弯的地方就是转弯处。

words.translation: 电视；电视, 转移向量
words.example_en: The children watch too much TV.
words.example_zh: 孩子们看电视太多。

defs.text: The assessed value of an asset from which the tax owing is computed.
An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.
defs.ex: It’s a good thing that television doesn’t transmit smell.

defs.text: A device for receiving television signals and displaying them in visual form.
defs.ex: I have an old television in the study.

words.exam_meaning: 电视；电视, 转移向量
words.collocation_hint: on TV; TV programs; watch TV
words.mnemonics: TV就是电视的缩写，看电视时眼睛盯着屏幕，记住TV=电视。

words.translation: 双胞胎中一人, 一对非常相像的人(或物)中的一个；双胞胎的, 成对的, 孪生的；生双胞胎, 成对
words.example_en: The twin goals are growth and stability.
words.example_zh: 双重目标是增长与稳定。

defs.text: Either of two people (or, less commonly, animals) who shared the same uterus at the same time; one who was born at the same birth as a sibling.
Either of two similar or closely related objects, entities etc.
A room in a hotel, guesthouse, etc. with two beds; a twin room.

words.exam_meaning: n. 双胞胎中一人, 一对非常相像的人(或物)中的一个；a. 双胞胎的, 成对的, 孪生的；vi. 生双胞胎, 成对
words.collocation_hint: twin goals; twin towers; twin cities
words.mnemonics: tw（two）+in，两个人在里面，就是双胞胎。

words.example_en: The story has an unexpected twist at the end.
words.example_zh: 这个故事结尾有意想不到的转折。
words.collocation_hint: twist of fate; an unexpected twist; twist the facts
words.mnemonics: twist像tw（two）加ist，两手一拧成扭曲，剧情一转是转折。

words.translation: 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式；打字；作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打
words.example_en: What type of research is this?
words.example_zh: 这是什么类型的研究？

defs.text: A grouping based on shared characteristics; a class.
defs.ex: This type of plane can handle rough weather more easily than that type of plane.

defs.text: An individual considered typical of its class, one regarded as typifying a certain profession, environment, etc.
An individual that represents the ideal for its class; an embodiment.

words.exam_meaning: n. 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式；vi. 打字；vt. 作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打
words.collocation_hint: type of; a type of; blood type
words.mnemonics: ty=type首字母，打字打出不同类型，联想：打字时选字体类型。

words.translation: 典型的, 象征性的；典型的
words.example_en: This is a typical example of the problem.
words.example_zh: 这是该问题的典型例子。

defs.text: Anything that is typical, normal, or standard.
defs.ex: Among the moths, typicals were more common than melanics.

defs.text: Capturing the overall sense of a thing.
Characteristically representing something by form, group, idea or type.

words.collocation_hint: typical of; a typical example; typical behavior
words.mnemonics: type（类型）+ical（形容词后缀）= 能代表某一类型的，就是典型的。

words.translation: 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的；丑陋的人(或物)
words.example_en: The ugly truth is that we failed.
words.example_zh: 难堪的事实是我们失败了。

defs.text: Ugliness.
An ugly person or thing.
A shade for the face, projecting from a bonnet.

words.exam_meaning: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的；n. 丑陋的人(或物)
words.collocation_hint: ugly truth; ugly side; an ugly scene
words.mnemonics: ugly谐音‘恶鬼’，又丑又险恶，像恶鬼一样吓人。

words.example_en: The ultimate goal is a cleaner environment.
words.example_zh: 最终目标是更清洁的环境。
words.collocation_hint: ultimate goal; the ultimate aim; ultimate responsibility
words.mnemonics: ult（远）+imate→走到最远尽头→最终的；最根本的。

words.translation: 遭受, 经历, 忍受；经受, 经历, 忍受
words.example_en: The city underwent rapid change.
words.example_zh: 这座城市经历了快速变化。

defs.text: To go or move under or beneath.
To experience; to pass through a phase.
defs.ex: The project is undergoing great changes.

defs.text: To suffer or endure; bear with.
defs.ex: She had to undergo surgery because of her broken leg.

words.collocation_hint: undergo change; undergo surgery; undergo reform
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+go（走）→ 在下面走一遍，即亲身经历、遭受。

words.translation: 本科生 adj. 本科的
words.example_en: Undergraduate students must attend lectures.
words.example_zh: 本科生必须上课。
words.exam_meaning: n. 本科生 adj. 本科的
words.collocation_hint: undergraduate students; undergraduate degree; an undergraduate at
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+ graduate（毕业生）→ 还没毕业的本科生，就是“本科的”。

words.example_en: The underlying cause of the crisis is debt.
words.example_zh: 危机的根本原因是债务。
words.collocation_hint: underlying cause; underlying problem; the underlying assumption
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+ lying（躺）→ 躺在表面之下的，就是潜在的、根本的。

words.example_en: Doubt can undermine confidence.
words.example_zh: 怀疑会削弱信心。
words.collocation_hint: undermine confidence; undermine the credibility; be undermined by
words.mnemonics: under（下面）+mine（挖矿）→在下面挖矿，根基被破坏，削弱力量。

words.example_en: It is hard to understand why he left.
words.example_zh: 很难理解他为什么离开。
words.collocation_hint: understand that; understand the importance; make sb understand
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+ stand（站）→ 站在下面听清楚，才能理解对方的意思。

words.translation: 理解, 谅解；协商, 协议, 谅解
words.example_en: The two sides reached an understanding.
words.example_zh: 双方达成了谅解。
words.exam_meaning: n. 理解, 谅解；协商, 协议, 谅解
words.collocation_hint: understanding of; mutual understanding; reach an understanding
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+standing（站立）=站在对方角度想，就是理解、谅解。

words.example_en: The government undertook a major reform.
words.example_zh: 政府着手进行重大改革。
words.collocation_hint: undertake a task; undertake research; undertake to do
words.mnemonics: under（在下面）+take（拿）→在下面拿起来，即承担起责任，着手从事。

words.example_en: Unemployment among the young is high.
words.example_zh: 年轻人失业率很高。
words.collocation_hint: unemployment rate; youth unemployment; rising unemployment
words.mnemonics: un（不）+ employment（就业）→ 不就业，就是失业。

words.example_en: Unfortunately, the plan failed.
words.example_zh: 不幸的是,计划失败了。

defs.text: Happening through bad luck, or because of some unfortunate event.
Used (as a parenthetical word) to express disappointment, compassion, sorrow, regret or grief.

words.exam_meaning: adv. 恐怕, 不幸的是
words.collocation_hint: unfortunately, the; but unfortunately; unfortunately for
words.mnemonics: un（不）+fortunate（幸运的）+ly（副词后缀）→不幸运地，即不幸的是。

words.translation: 制服；统一的, 一律的, 始终如一的
words.example_en: The rooms are uniform in size.
words.example_zh: 房间大小一致。

defs.text: A distinctive outfit that serves to identify members of a group.
Phonetic equivalent for the letter U in the ICAO spelling alphabet, informally known as the NATO phonetic alphabet.
A uniformed police officer (as opposed to a detective).

words.collocation_hint: uniform of; in uniform; school uniform
words.mnemonics: uni（单一）+ form（形式）→ 单一形式，即统一的；穿统一服装就是制服。

words.example_en: The new currency helped unify the country's markets.
words.example_zh: 新货币帮助统一了国内市场。
words.mnemonics: uni（一）+fy（使动），使变成一，即统一。

words.translation: 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会；联合; 联管节; 活接头
words.example_en: The trade union defended the workers.
words.example_zh: 工会为工人辩护。

defs.text: The act of uniting or joining two or more things into one.
The state of being united or joined; a state of unity or harmony.
That which is united, or made one; something formed by a combination or coalition of parts or members; a confederation; a consolidated body; a league.

words.exam_meaning: n. 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会；联合; 联管节; 活接头
words.collocation_hint: union of; trade union; the European Union
words.mnemonics: uni（一个）+on（在…上）→大家站在同一条线上→联盟、联合。

words.example_en: The region has a unique culture.
words.example_zh: 这个地区有独特的文化。
words.collocation_hint: unique to; a unique opportunity; unique features
words.mnemonics: uni（单一）+que（形容词后缀）= 独一无二，记住“uni”就是“一”，一个的就是独特。

words.translation: 单位, 分队, 部队, 单元, 部件, 装置；单位的, 单元的；单元常数; 部件
words.example_en: The family is the basic unit of society.
words.example_zh: 家庭是社会的基本单位。

defs.text: A particular, minute unit of mass, defined differently for different substances, but so that varying substances of the same general type have the property that one international unit of the one has the same effect on the human body as one international unit of the other.
Oneness, singularity, seen as a component of a whole number; a magnitude of one.
A standard measure of a quantity.

words.example_en: The vessel sailed across the Pacific.
words.example_zh: 这艘船横渡太平洋。
words.collocation_hint: vessel of; a vessel for; blood vessels
words.mnemonics: vessel像“喂水”，船和容器都能装水，血管也装血。

words.translation: 老手, 退伍军人, 老兵, 老树；老兵的, 老练的, 经验丰富的
words.example_en: The veteran teacher retired this year.
words.example_zh: 这位资深教师今年退休了。
words.collocation_hint: veteran of; a war veteran; veteran players
words.mnemonics: vet（兽医）+eran→老兽医经验丰富，是老手，也像退伍老兵一样有资历。

words.translation: 经由, 经过, 通过；病毒灭活剂
words.example_en: The news spread via social media.
words.example_zh: 消息通过社交媒体传播。

defs.text: A main road or highway, especially in ancient Rome. (Mainly used in set phrases, below.)
A small hole in a printed circuit board filled with metal which connects two or more layers.

words.collocation_hint: via the internet; via email; travel via
words.mnemonics: “via”像“维他命”的“维”，吃维他命要通过嘴巴进入身体，即“经由、通过”。

words.example_en: Solar power is now a viable alternative to coal.
words.example_zh: 太阳能如今是煤炭的可行替代方案。
words.mnemonics: vi（路）+able（能）→ 能走通的路，即可行的；生命能走通，即能存活的。

words.translation: 受害人, 牺牲者, 牺牲品；受害人, 被害人, 遭难者
words.example_en: The victims of the flood received aid.
words.example_zh: 洪水灾民得到了援助。

defs.text: One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceived, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:
defs.ex: the youngest victims of the brutal war

defs.text: A living being which is slain and offered as a sacrifice, usually in a religious rite.

words.collocation_hint: victim of; the victims of; fall victim to
words.mnemonics: victim像victory（胜利）的牺牲品，胜利背后总有受害人。

words.translation: 胜利, 战胜, 克服
words.example_en: The victory was hard-won.
words.example_zh: 这场胜利来之不易。

defs.text: An instance of having won a competition or battle or succeeded in an effort.
defs.ex: It was a great victory on the battlefield.

defs.text: The condition of having succeeded in a conflict or other effort.
A winged figure representing victory, common in Roman official iconography. See Winged victory.

words.exam_meaning: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
words.collocation_hint: victory over; win a victory; a victory for
words.mnemonics: vict（征服）+ory（名词后缀），征服对手就是胜利。

words.translation: 影像, 电视；图像的, 电视的
words.example_en: The video went viral online.
words.example_zh: 这段视频在网上疯传。

defs.text: Television, television show, movie.
A short film clip, with or without audio (as in a music video, or one of the plethora of user-generated short movies on sites such as YouTube).
Motion picture stored on VHS or some other format.

words.exam_meaning: n. 影像, 电视；a. 图像的, 电视的
words.collocation_hint: video of; watch a video; video games
words.mnemonics: vid=看，eo=东西，能看的东西就是视频。

words.translation: 视野, 风景, 见解, 视力, 观看, 视图, 指望, 意图, 印象；看, 考虑, 视察, 查看, 估量；视图
words.example_en: The report takes a different view.
words.example_zh: 报告持不同观点。

defs.text: (physical) Visual perception.
A picture, drawn or painted; a sketch.
defs.ex: a fine view of Lake George

defs.text: (psychological) Opinion, judgement, imagination.

words.collocation_hint: view of; in view of; point of view
words.mnemonics: view=vi(看)+ew，看东西就是“看”，看问题就是“考虑”，看完形成“见解”。

words.example_en: He violated the rules of the club.
words.example_zh: 他违反了俱乐部的规定。
words.collocation_hint: violate the law; violate the rules; violate the rights of
words.mnemonics: vi(六)+olate(olate像old)，六次违反老规矩，侵犯他人权益。

words.translation: 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行；暴行, 暴力, 暴乱
words.example_en: The government condemned the violence.
words.example_zh: 政府谴责暴力行为。

defs.text: Extreme force.
defs.ex: The violence of the storm, fortunately, was more awesome than destructive.

defs.text: Action which causes destruction, pain, or suffering.
defs.ex: We try to avoid violence in resolving conflicts.

defs.text: Widespread fighting.
defs.ex: Violence between the government and the rebels continues.

words.exam_meaning: n. 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行；暴行, 暴力, 暴乱
words.collocation_hint: violence against; domestic violence; acts of violence
words.mnemonics: vio（=viol，力量）+lence，用力量强行对待他人，就是暴力。

words.translation: 暴力的, 猛烈的, 激烈的, 极端的, 凶暴的
words.example_en: The film contains violent scenes.
words.example_zh: 这部电影包含暴力场面。

defs.text: An assailant.
To urge with violence.
Involving extreme force or motion.
defs.ex: A violent wind ripped the branch from the tree.

words.collocation_hint: violent crime; a violent reaction; violent protests
words.mnemonics: viol（暴力）+ent（形容词后缀），联想“violence（暴力）”，记住“暴力的、猛烈的”即可。

words.example_en: The company holds virtual meetings.
words.example_zh: 公司举行虚拟会议。
words.collocation_hint: virtual reality; virtual meeting; virtually impossible
words.mnemonics: vir(真实)+tual→看似真实但非真实，即虚拟；但实际效果又等同真实，即实际上。

words.example_en: The cost has virtually doubled.
words.example_zh: 成本几乎翻了一番。

defs.text: Almost but not quite.
defs.ex: With our medicare supplemental insurance plan, there are virtually no claim forms to fill out. (Advertisement)

defs.text: Without exaggeration.
In essence, but not in fact.

words.collocation_hint: virtually impossible; virtually no; virtually identical
words.mnemonics: virtual（虚拟的）+ly，虚拟世界几乎等于现实，所以是“几乎、实际上”。

words.translation: 德行, 美德, 优点, 功效, 效力；美德, 贞操, 优点
words.example_en: Patience is a virtue.
words.example_zh: 耐心是一种美德。

defs.text: Accordance with moral principles; conformity of behaviour or thought with the strictures of morality; good moral conduct.
defs.ex: Without virtue, there is no freedom.

defs.text: A particular manifestation of moral excellence in a person; an admirable quality.
Specifically, each of several qualities held to be particularly important, including the four cardinal virtues, the three theological virtues, or the seven virtues opposed to the seven deadly sins.

words.collocation_hint: virtue of; by virtue of; the virtue of
words.mnemonics: vir（男人）+tue，古代认为男人要有美德，即勇敢正直，引申为优点和功效。

words.translation: 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害；病毒
words.example_en: The virus spreads through the air.
words.example_zh: 这种病毒通过空气传播。

defs.text: A submicroscopic, non-cellular structure consisting of a core of DNA or RNA surrounded by a protein coat, that requires a living host cell to replicate, and often causes disease in the host organism.
A disease caused by these organisms.
defs.ex: He caught a virus and had to stay home from school.

defs.text: Venom, as produced by a poisonous animal etc.

words.exam_meaning: n. 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害；病毒
words.collocation_hint: virus of; computer virus; spread of the virus
words.mnemonics: vi（谐音‘歪’）+rus（谐音‘如斯’），病毒歪歪扭扭如斯，害人不浅。

words.translation: 看得见的, 明显的, 显然的；可见物
words.example_en: The results are visible within a month.
words.example_zh: 结果在一个月内可见。

defs.text: Able to be seen.
defs.ex: When the sun rises, the world becomes visible.

words.collocation_hint: visible in; clearly visible; become visible
words.mnemonics: vis-看 + -ible能…的，能看见的就是明显的。

words.translation: 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想；梦见, 想象, 显示
words.example_en: The company has a clear vision for the future.
words.example_zh: 公司对未来有清晰的愿景。

defs.text: The sense or ability of sight.
Something seen; an object perceived visually.
Something imaginary one thinks one sees.
defs.ex: He tried drinking from the pool of water, but realized it was only a vision.

words.collocation_hint: vision of; a clear vision; the vision for
words.mnemonics: vis=看，-ion名词后缀；看的能力就是视觉，看长远就是眼光。

words.example_en: The president visited the region.
words.example_zh: 总统访问了该地区。
words.collocation_hint: visit to; pay a visit; visit the site
words.mnemonics: visit=vis(看)+it(它)，去看它，就是参观或拜访。

words.translation: 参观者, 游客, 访客；视察人, 检视人, 检查员
words.example_en: The museum welcomes thousands of visitors.
words.example_zh: 博物馆每年接待成千上万的游客。

defs.text: Someone who visits someone else; someone staying as a guest.
Someone who pays a visit to a specific place or event; a sightseer or tourist.
(usually in the plural) Someone, or a team, that is playing away from home.

words.exam_meaning: n. 参观者, 游客, 访客；视察人, 检视人, 检查员
words.collocation_hint: visitor to; foreign visitors; a visitor from
words.mnemonics: visit（参观）+ or（人）= 来参观的人，就是访客。

words.translation: 视觉的；视觉的, 视力的, 视觉性记忆优势者
words.example_en: The report includes visual aids.
words.example_zh: 报告包含视觉辅助材料。

defs.text: Any element of something that depends on sight.
An image; a picture; a graphic.
(in the plural) All the visual elements of a multimedia presentation or entertainment, usually in contrast with normal text or audio.

words.exam_meaning: a. 视觉的；视觉的, 视力的, 视觉性记忆优势者
words.collocation_hint: visual aids; visual effects; visual representation of
words.mnemonics: vis（看）+ual（形容词后缀）→用来看的，即视觉的。

words.example_en: Education is vital to national development.
words.example_zh: 教育对国家发展至关重要。
words.collocation_hint: vital to; play a vital role; vital information
words.mnemonics: vit=生命，如vita生命，关系到生命的就是“至关重要的”。

words.example_en: She gave a vivid description of the scene.
words.example_zh: 她生动地描述了那个场景。
words.collocation_hint: vivid description; vivid memories; in vivid detail
words.mnemonics: “维维”豆奶广告画面生动鲜明，让人记忆深刻。

words.example_en: Reading expands your vocabulary.
words.example_zh: 阅读能扩大词汇量。
words.collocation_hint: vocabulary of; basic vocabulary; a large vocabulary
words.mnemonics: voca（说）+bulary（物）→说出来的东西就是词汇，背单词就是积累词汇量。

words.example_en: The institute offers vocational training for young people.
words.example_zh: 该学院为年轻人提供职业培训。
words.mnemonics: voca（声音）+tion（名词）+al（形容词），跟着职业的召唤声走，就是职业的。

words.translation: 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态；表达, 吐露, 调音
words.example_en: The report gives voice to the workers.
words.example_zh: 报告为工人发声。

defs.text: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character
defs.ex: His low voice allowed him to become a bass in the choir.

defs.text: Sound made through vibration of the vocal cords; sonant, or intonated, utterance; tone; — distinguished from mere breath sound as heard in whispering and voiceless consonants.
The tone or sound emitted by an object

words.collocation_hint: voice of; raise one's voice; in a low voice
words.mnemonics: voice谐音‘我嘶’，我嘶哑着嗓子发声，表达想法。

words.translation: 册, 卷, 体积, 容量, 大量, 许多, 份量, 音量；成团卷起；把...收集成卷
words.example_en: The volume of trade has increased.
words.example_zh: 贸易量增加了。

defs.text: A three-dimensional measure of space that comprises a length, a width and a height. It is measured in units of cubic centimeters in metric, cubic inches or cubic feet in English measurement.
defs.ex: The room is 9x12x8, so its volume is 864 cubic feet.

defs.text: Strength of sound; loudness.
defs.ex: Please turn down the volume on the stereo.

defs.text: The issues of a periodical over a period of one year.
defs.ex: I looked at this week's copy of the magazine. It was volume 23, issue 45.

words.collocation_hint: volume of; the volume of trade; sales volume
words.mnemonics: vol（意愿）+ume，愿意装下的量就是容量，声音装得下就是音量。

words.example_en: If a man accidentally kills another by lopping a tree, it is not voluntary manslaughter.
words.mnemonics: vol=意志，unt=行动，自己按意志行动，就是自愿的。

words.example_en: She volunteers at the local hospital.
words.example_zh: 她在当地医院做志愿者。

defs.text: One who enters into, or offers for, any service of his/her own free will, especially when done without pay.

One who enters into military service voluntarily, but who, when in service, is subject to discipline and regulations like other soldiers; -- opposed to conscript; specifically, a voluntary member of the organized militia of a country as distinguished from the standing army.
A person who acts out of his own will without a legal obligation, such as a donor.

words.exam_meaning: n. 志愿者；a. 志愿的；v. 自愿
words.collocation_hint: volunteer for; a volunteer at; volunteer work
words.mnemonics: vol（意愿）+unt（人）+eer（人），有“意愿”的人就是志愿者，自愿去做。

words.translation: 投票, 选举, 选票, 表决, 选举权, 得票数；投票, 选举；投票选举, 投票决定, 公认, 使投票
words.example_en: The parliament voted on the bill.
words.example_zh: 议会对法案进行了投票。

defs.text: A formalized choice on matters of administration or other democratic activities
defs.ex: One occasion indicative votes were used was in 2003 when MPs were presented with seven different options on how to reform the House of Lords.

defs.text: An act or instance of participating in such a choice, e.g., by submitting a ballot
defs.ex: The Supreme Court upheld the principle of one person, one vote.

defs.text: An ardent wish or desire; a vow; a prayer

words.collocation_hint: vote for; vote against; the right to vote
words.mnemonics: v（胜利）+ote（谐音“哦提”），投票选胜利者，哦，提他！

words.example_en: The voyage across the ocean took two months.
words.example_zh: 横渡大洋的航行花了两个月。
words.collocation_hint: voyage of; on a voyage; the voyage to
words.mnemonics: voy（路）+age（名词后缀），走水路的路程，即航行。

words.example_en: Children are vulnerable to the disease.
words.example_zh: 儿童容易感染这种疾病。
words.collocation_hint: vulnerable to; vulnerable groups; be vulnerable to attack
words.mnemonics: vulner=伤口，able=易…的，有伤口就容易受伤，所以是脆弱的。

words.translation: 工资, 报应, 报偿；开展, 进行；进行
words.example_en: The workers demanded higher wages.
words.example_zh: 工人要求提高工资。
words.collocation_hint: wage of; minimum wage; wage increases
words.mnemonics: wage像‘喂鸡’，喂鸡要给工钱，干活要‘进行’。

words.example_en: Wait here until your car arrives.
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: wait=等，-ing表进行，正在等就是等待。

words.example_en: The plan hit a wall of opposition.
words.example_zh: 计划遇到了强烈的反对。
words.collocation_hint: wall of; the wall between; build a wall
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: wall 谐音‘我’，墙围着我，形成屏障。

words.translation: 游荡, 漫步, 徘徊, 迷路, 离题, 蜿蜒；在...漫游
words.example_en: His mind wandered during the lecture.
words.example_zh: 讲座期间他走神了。

defs.text: The act or instance of wandering.
defs.ex: to go for a wander in the park

defs.text: The situation where a value or signal etc. deviates from the correct or normal value.
defs.ex: baseline wander in ECG signals

defs.text: To move without purpose or specified destination; often in search of livelihood.
defs.ex: to wander over the fields

words.collocation_hint: wander off; wander through; mind wanders
words.mnemonics: wan（玩）+der（的）→ 出去玩的时候，到处漫步、徘徊，还容易离题跑偏。

words.example_en: The company wants to expand overseas.
words.example_zh: 公司想向海外扩张。
words.collocation_hint: want to do; want for; for want of
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: want 谐音“忘他”，想要却忘了带，所以需要、缺乏。

words.translation: 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争；进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗；战争的, 战时用的
words.example_en: The war lasted eight years.
words.example_zh: 战争持续了八年。

defs.text: Organized, large-scale, armed conflict between countries or between national, ethnic, or other sizeable groups, usually involving the engagement of military forces.
defs.ex: The war was largely between Sunni and Shia militants.

defs.text: A particular conflict of this kind.
(by extension) Any conflict, or anything resembling a conflict.
defs.ex: You look like you've been through the wars.

words.exam_meaning: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争；vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗；a. 战争的, 战时用的
words.collocation_hint: war of; at war; civil war
words.mnemonics: war像“我”在战场上“啊”地喊，战争就是冲突斗争。

words.example_en: She works in the children's ward.
words.example_zh: 她在儿童病房工作。
words.collocation_hint: ward off; a hospital ward; ward of
words.mnemonics: war（战争）+d→战争时伤员住病房，需要守护。

words.translation: 警告, 提醒, 通知；发出警告
words.example_en: Experts warned of the risks.
words.example_zh: 专家警告了风险。

defs.text: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To caution or admonish (someone) against unwise or unacceptable behaviour.
defs.ex: Don't let me catch you running in the corridor again, I warn you.

defs.text: (chiefly with "off", "away", and similar words) To advise or order to go or stay away.
defs.ex: A sign warns trespassers off/away from the site.

words.collocation_hint: warn of; warn against; warn sb that
words.mnemonics: 谐音“卧恩”，像“卧倒+恩赐”，危险来了先卧倒，提醒大家注意。

words.translation: 授权；正当理由 v. 使有必要
words.example_en: The evidence does not warrant such a harsh penalty.
words.example_zh: 证据不足以证明如此严厉的处罚是合理的。
words.mnemonics: war（战争）+rant（咆哮）→ 战争咆哮需要授权，才有正当理由。

words.translation: 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物；废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的；浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜
words.example_en: The report says the plan wastes public money.
words.example_zh: 报告称该计划浪费公共资金。

defs.text: Excess of material, useless by-products or damaged, unsaleable products; garbage; rubbish.
Excrement or urine.
defs.ex: The cage was littered with animal waste

defs.text: A waste land; an uninhabited desolate region; a wilderness or desert.

words.collocation_hint: waste of; waste time; plastic waste
words.mnemonics: waste像'歪死特'，东西歪了死了就浪费了，变成废物。

words.example_en: Leaving the lights on all night is wasteful of energy.
words.example_zh: 整夜不关灯浪费能源。
words.mnemonics: waste（浪费）+ ful（充满…的）→ 充满浪费的，即浪费的。

words.example_en: The committee watches over public spending.
words.example_zh: 委员会监督公共支出。
words.collocation_hint: watch over; watch out for; keep watch
words.mnemonics: watch=看+守，眼睛盯着看，既看时间也看人。

words.example_en: The fields are watered by the river.
words.example_zh: 田地由河流灌溉。
words.collocation_hint: water of; clean water; water supply
words.note: 基础补全词：本地不硬填释义，首次学习/查词时通过在线词典或AI补全，避免错误释义。
words.mnemonics: water 就是水，口渴要喝水，浇花也要 water，记住水和浇水两个核心意思就够了。

words.translation: 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变；波动, 飘动, 挥手示意, 起伏；使波动, 使飘扬, 挥舞, 使成波浪形
words.example_en: The reform set off a wave of change.
